chapters.title: Chapter 3631: Rolling Stone Wasteland
paragraphs: Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations
Day after day, time passed very quickly.

After nine days, Ling Han had completely mastered the “An” chant. He opened his mouth to chant, and the sound of Buddha was vast and mighty. If one didn’t look at him, they would think that this was a bald monk.
Ling Han was very satisfied, but the little loli was depressed to the extreme. There was still no second leaf that fell from the tree.
Damn it, she was being bullied here.
However, by the tenth day, Ling Han still hadn’t been able to derive anything from the Bodhi Tree. Repeating it again and again, it was only the elaboration of the “An” chant.
This was an inheritance of only one character?

Ling Han pondered for a moment before coming to a sudden realization. The Bodhi Tree had already wilted and been destroyed, and the inheritance had also been destroyed. It was already extremely fortunate that he had been able to learn a complete “An” character.
He related this deduction to Tang Yun’er, and the little loli was naturally very disappointed.
“Handsome Brother, then pass it on to me,” she said.
Ling Han shook his head. It wasn’t that he didn’t want to teach her, but rather that he couldn’t.

Otherwise, the Buddhist Race didn’t need the Bodhi Inheritance or whatnot. Wouldn’t it be much simpler to just pass it on by word of mouth? You see, he had waited here for nine days, and only then did he learna single chant of An. This efficiency was really too low.
“Forget it, I’m not going to learn anymore.” Tang Yun’er was peeved, and she was extremely unhappy.
If it was any other adult, they would definitely continue to stay. Even if they only obtained the An character, it was a supreme secret technique.
But who asked this little loli to only be six or seven years old?
How could a six- or seven-year-old child consider so much? She would definitely be throwing a tantrum.
“You really don’t want to learn anymore?” Ling Han asked.
“No!” Tang Yun’er shook her head, her attitude resolute.
“If you don’t want to learn, then don’t.” Ling Han originally wanted her to stay here, while he himself went to get the essence of Metal. In any case, the little girl wouldn’t be of much help.
The two of them left, and began their journey of fighting monsters again.
A few days later, they reunited with the seven babies.
“Father, you’ve disappeared for several days. Did you have another fortuitous encounter? Did the essence of Metal we gathered go to waste again?” Fourth Baby asked.
Ling Han smiled and said, “How’s that possible? I did have a fortuitous encounter, but I didn’t obtain the Metal Element Crystal.”
He related the matter of obtaining the Six Characters Bright King Curse, which also surprised the babies.
“Father, could it be that you have the bloodline of the Buddhist Race?” Third Baby bit her finger and said. “Otherwise, why would the Bodhi Tree recognize you and cast down leaves?”
“Yi, is there something like that?”
Tang Yun’er’s eyes widened, and she instantly felt extremely displeased. As it turned out, she had really gone to all this trouble for nothing?
Ling Han shook his head. He definitely didn’t have any relationship with the baldies. Moreover, he said, “Isn’t the Buddhist Race a collective name? What bloodline would there be?”

“Father, you don’t know about this, do you?” Eldest Baby shook her head, “The Buddhist Race also has a bloodline, but it is not birthing children in the traditional sense, but rather there is speaking of reincarnation of the great elites of the Buddhist Race. Some infants are born proficient in Buddhism, and will definitely become great elites of the Buddhist Race.”
“Father, are you a reincarnated Buddha?” Second Baby stroked Ling Han’s head, and said, “Father, if you convert to Buddhist Race one day, you’ll lose your hair.”
“While it’s still here, let’s hurry up and look at it,” Fifth Baby said with a smile.
“En!” The other children nodded respectively.
Ling Han’s expression was dark, “I won’t become a monk!”
He had many wives and children, so how could he become a monk?
Tang Yun’er interjected in an untimely manner, “Actually, the Buddhist Race also has the branch of the Delightful Buddha. Marriage is not forbidden, and there is no need to cut your hair either.”
“Get lost,” Ling Han said in displeasure. ‘If you don’t speak, I won’t treat you as a mute.’
“Hahahaha!” The children and the little loli all laughed.

They continued to fight monsters, collecting the essence of Metal. Ling Han and Shen Hanyun met, and after another half a month, they finally gathered enough essence of Metal, fusing it into a Metal Element Crystal.
Finally, he was missing one out of five. He was close to completing his mission.
“Next stop, the Rolling Stone Wasteland!”
They set out, heading towards the last location of the Five Elements. This took some time, and after five days, they finally arrived at their destination.

Since it was a desolate plain, it was naturally a barren land. This place was covered with scorched earth, and there were few plants. However, thankfully, it was not as hot as the Golden Desert, and there were also rivers surging, so there was no need to worry about dying of thirst here.

Everyone still moved separately, and agreed to meet up once every five days. For example, if anyone’s luck was off the charts and directly collected the Earth Element Crystal, the mission would be completed.
However, after only two days, Ling Han began his seclusion.
He could break through again.

After cultivating in seclusion for half a day, Ling Han opened nine more apertures. Now, he was only nine aperture away from the end of the Enlightenment Tier. Of course, this didn’t take into account Hidden Apertures.
Tang Yun’er soon became bored. She hid into the gourd and snored loudly.
Ling Han was also very bored, but there was nothing he could do. This was for his own benefit.
He advanced, searching for Earth Element creatures.

There were many, all of them made up of round rocks. There were no joints at all, yet they could be attached together, which was very amazing. However, their strength was only so-so. With Ling Han’s current battle prowess, he could easily deal with them with a single finger.
Unless he encountered a Stone King, he would be able to sweep aside all obstacles with his eyes closed.
All of a sudden, goosebumps rose all over his body, and he felt a strong sense of danger assault him.
He suddenly turned around, only to see a person striding over from the front.

This was an energetic and handsome young man. His appearance was practically perfect, and there was not the slightest flaw to be found. He was dressed all in white, and carried a sword on his back. His black hair fell over his shoulders, glossy and ink blank.
What Ling Han cared about was naturally not his appearance, but rather the aura that this person was exuding.
It was as sharp as a sword, and incredibly terrifying.
This kind of aura was something that even Hong Tianbu couldn’t compare to. En, Hong Tianbu could only compare to him after he opened the Eye of the Primordial Beast.
“I’ve finally found you,” the person in white said with a smile.
Ling Han also smiled faintly, “I don’t think I recognize you. Thank you for your hard work. I’m really embarrassed.”
The white-robed person faltered, then laughed loudly, “You are more interesting than I had imagined.”
“I have always been a humorous person.” Ling Han shrugged.
Yet the white-robed man withdrew his smile, and said, “My name is He San.”
Ling Han gave an ‘oh’. What He San and He Si? He did not recognize them at all.
He San was surprised. The other party actually did not change at all after hearing his name? That’s right, this person definitely did not know his identity.
He did not explain either. There was no need to waste this time.
“I’ll kill you,” he said.

Ling Han nodded, “I don’t have any friends here either. You have especially come to find me, and I can also guess that you have come to kill me. Let me think. Firstly, the Pang and Lei Clans should not be able to get a prodigy like you to come here, and secondly, they too think that I am dead, and would not expend so much effort.”
He paused, then continued, “So, you should be one of His Imperial Highness’s men, right?”
He San smiled, “He is still unable to command me. However, an heir of our Empire was almost killed by you, and you ruined a great matter of his. Since I now know, I naturally have to make this trip.”
“You, commit suicide..”

chapters.title: Chapter 3632: Battling He San
paragraphs: Translator: Henyee Translations | Editor: Henyee Translations
‘Commit suicide.’
Ling Han felt as if he had heard many people say this before. He had always felt that it was very foolish.
Of course, when He San said this, he naturally did not think that he was an idiot. He was only showing off.
This person was qualified to show off.

Ling Han chuckled and said, “There are many people who want to kill me, but you see, I’m still alive and well. So, you still have to work hard.” “Cheeky mouth!” He San moved, and delivered a palm strike towards Ling Han.
Boom, with a palm strike, winds and clouds rose.

This was indeed a super genius. He himself should be a three-star genius. Furthermore, after advancing into the Celestial Path, he was now suppressed to Mystery Realm Tier. No matter what, he could still retain some battle prowess.
Thus, in the case of Mystery Realm Tier elites, He San could be considered a four-star genius.

This naturally couldn’t compare to Ling Han. He was a 4.5-star genius, or even close to five-star genius. However, his disadvantage was his cultivation level. After all, Ling Han was only at the Enlightenment Tier.
■Come, let’s battle it out then.’
Ling Han clenched a fist, and greeted He San’s attack.
Boom, their attacks clashed, and Ling Han couldn’t help but somersault, retreating continuously.
“Yi?” He San looked surprised, “You actually managed to block a palm strike
from me?”
With how prodigious he was, this attack should have easily killed Ling Han.
“NO wonder Meng Yangcheng was forced to flee by himself. You do indeed have some abilities.” He nodded, and gave Ling Han a considerably high assessment.
Meng Yangcheng?
That so-called Imperial Highness?

Ling Han stopped. At present, he was practically capable of sweeping aside all Mystery Realm Tiers, but against a three-star genius, it was still a bit difficult, what more when the present He San might not only be just a three-star genius.
He stretched his arms and legs, and said, “Aren’t you afraid of being attacked out of your wits by me?”
He San’s expression darkened, “To be able to survive a single move from me, you can indeed be proud, but to act arrogant in front of me, that is a great mistake!”

chapters.title: Chapter 3633 - Run
paragraphs: Run
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations

He San smirked coldly. This was also a secret technique, and it was incredibly difficult to cultivate. Even if he publicized the secret scroll, there would not be more than three people that could grasp it.
He took advantage of the opening to counterattack, and shot out a kick, which turned into a powerful surge of Qi that looked like a True Dragon.
Ling Han shattered the air with his Destructive Energy, instantly regaining his freedom.

He activated the Eighteen Claws of the Golden Eagle, and his body soared into the sky like an eagle. Regardless of whether you were a primordial wild elephant or a wild bull, you were still only his hunting target.

He San was unafraid. The only thing that he didn’t dare to come into contact with was the Destructive Energy. So what if it was the Eighteen Claws of the Golden Eagle? He had a celestial technique that could rival it.
The two of them battled fiercely, and Ling Han was still at a disadvantage.
The suppression of the cultivation level of a major tier was really too helpless. And if anyone knew the true cultivation level of the two of them, they would definitely think that Ling Han had won.
In a battle of equal cultivation levels, Ling Han was completely capable of beating He San up.
Unfortunately, how could there be a truly fair battle in this world?
If He San found out that Ling Han was actually only an Enlightenment Tier, his killing intent would definitely be even hotter, and he would kill Ling Han at all costs.
This kind of person was too freakish. Just being alive was enough to make one feel flustered. He was practically a nightmare for prodigies.

Ling Han had no choice but to admit that the other was indeed powerful. He was no match for him when he was at a cultivation level weaker than him by a major tier. However, how could he be someone who would give up so easily? His hands formed a strange pose.
Instantly, a frightening aura exuded from his body, as if he had suddenly become the centre of heaven and earth.
He San couldn’t help but feel shocked. Although Ling Han hadn’t made a move yet, he already felt a coldness as if a storm was about to come.
The impact of this one strike was bound to be earth-shattering.
He didn’t dare to be careless, and faced it with seriousness.
Boom, Ling Han unleashed the Three Styles of the God of War. He formed his hands into palms and delivered a palm strike at He San.
The power of heaven and earth surged, all of which was absorbed by his body. Then, acting as a medium, it blasted out majestically.
Even He San was shocked, his eyes flickering. Though he had already had a high estimate of this move, he still felt apprehensive when this move was used.
He roared loudly, and also channeled his strongest ultimate technique to clash head-on with Ling Han.
He was He San, and he was definitely not inferior to anyone!
Boom!
In this exchange, Ling Han was still outmatched, and stumbled back. However, he immediately pulled himself together, and blasted out the second move of the Three Styles of God of War.
He was truly like a god of war, his whole body suffused with blood and Qi, as if he had just fought a bloody battle.
He charged over with this powerful move, as if he could crush everything.
He San did not back down either. He still sent out a heavy palm strike, greeting Ling Han’s attack.
Boom, the two of them exchanged another blow. This time, Ling Han was not at a disadvantage at all, and tied with He San.
The Three Styles of the God of War borrowed the power of heaven and earth, and each style was stronger than the last.
Ling Han forcefully suppressed the boiling sensation in his chest as he unleashed the third strike.
“Do you think I’m afraid of you!” He San roared in fury, greeting the incoming attack with a palm strike.
This was the ultimate technique that he had mastered, the Ultimate Mountain Palm, and was also his strongest technique at present.
Boom!
In this clash, He San was instantly sent flying heavily.
The Three Styles of the God of War was extremely powerful.
However, this was also Ling Han’s limit.
The blood in his body was extremely chaotic, and he was also experiencing waves of agonizing pain. He was already unable to use the Three Styles of the God of War a second time.

Though He San had been sent flying, his face was only slightly pale, and he had not sustained any serious injury. He smirked coldly, “Though this set of techniques of yours is powerful, and has increased your battle prowess by at least tenfold, the burden it places on you is at least a hundredfold.”
“Can you cast the next move?”
Ling Han had almost used all of his ultimate moves, and the only powerful killer move he had yet to use was the Heavenly Pattern Jade.
However, this was only a one-time thing. If he failed to defeat his opponent, and instead fell into the latter’s hands, he would suffer a great loss.
Let’s go.
He no longer hesitated. Using the Imminent Skyline, he covered a distance of 50 kilometers with a single step.

“Don’t even think about leaving!” He San hurriedly gave chase, but Ling Han took another step forwards, and instantly threw him off his tail. When he had taken a few more steps, it was already impossible to determine which direction Ling Han had gone.

He frowned. Though this opponent was not as freakish as himself, he was just barely qualified to be his opponent. After all, his cultivation level had descended from Celestial Path, and had a certain advantage.
If his opponent’s cultivation level was completely the same as his, perhaps he really could pose a threat to him.
Thus, he definitely had to get rid of this person.

It was clear that he was here to harvest the essence of Earth. His motive was very clear, and that was for the sake of obtaining the Five Elements Karmic Pill. Thus, before he had gathered enough essence of Earth, it was impossible for him to leave. Otherwise, all his previous efforts would be wasted.
“I will definitely find you and kill you!” He San said in a low voice, his tone baleful.
After Ling Han cast the Imminent Skyline a few times, he finally switched to a normal speed.
He was extremely displeased. This time, he was being suppressed in all aspects.
It couldn’t be helped. His opponent’s cultivation level was now one major tier higher than his, and he was a three-star genius. Of course, he was just that powerful.
“Even if I open the Hidden Apertures, it would still be impossible for me to be a match for him, unless... I advance into Mystery Realm Tier!”

Ling Han frowned. Opening the Hidden Apertures wasn’t like the Sixth Change or Seventh Change, where the improvement was so fierce. This was only paving the way for the future. The more Hidden Apertures opened, the faster the rate of cultivation would be in the future, but for the improvement of battle prowess?
With more leaps in level of being, breaking through more barriers, battle prowess would definitely become stronger, but there shouldn’t be any qualitative improvement.
After running far enough, Ling Han’s body had mostly recovered. In terms of the toughness of his physique, He San was far from being able to compare to him.
He continued to fight monsters. He would remember this debt from He San first.
However, only two days later, He San caught up to him, and immediately launched an attack. It was as if he was determined to kill him.
This time, Ling Han didn’t linger in battle. Instead, he directly used Imminent Skyline and left.

There was no need to argue with He San now. His priority was to obtain the Earth Element Crystal, and from there, concoct the Five Elements Karmic Pill, so that he could break through all the shackles in his body.
He only had to advance into Mystery Realm Tier, and in a real battle of equals, let’s see how he would beat up this b@stard.
Though He San was powerful, he did not have any good strategy against a godly skill like the Imminent Skyline. He could only watch helplessly as Ling Han fled, and then set off in pursuit again.
He wanted to rely on his advantage of having a high cultivation level and accumulation of power to forcefully exhaust Ling Han to death.
He seemed to have a unique method. This time, only a day later, he found Ling Han again, and began a mad barrage of attacks.
However, though his tracking technique was awesome, it was still unable to do anything against Ling Han’s Imminent Skyline.
For ten consecutive days, Ling Han was found eight times by He San, so he did not even have a moment of peace when he was fighting monsters.
However, under such high pressure, his cultivation level was also rapidly increasing.
He quickly opened the last nine apertures, reaching the publicly acknowledged limit of the Enlightenment Tier.

After opening 108 apertures, one could break through again. No matter where one was, this could be considered a prodigy. The majority of people had already opened 72 apertures, and no longer had the potential to charge forwards.
However, Ling Han knew that his path as an Enlightenment Tier elite had only truly begun at this moment.
He San, just give me more pressure, so that I can complete my breakthrough..

However, though his tracking technique was awesome, it was still unable to do anything against Ling Han’s Imminent Skyline.
For ten consecutive days, Ling Han was found eight times by He San, so he did not even have a moment of peace when he was fighting monsters.
However, under such high pressure, his cultivation level was also rapidly increasing.
He quickly opened the last nine apertures, reaching the publicly acknowledged limit of the Enlightenment Tier.
After opening 108 apertures, one could break through again.
No matter where one was, this could be considered a prodigy.
The majority of people had already opened 72 apertures, and no longer had the potential to charge forwards.
However, Ling Han knew that his path as an Enlightenment Tier elite had only truly begun at this moment.
He San, just give me more pressure, so that I can complete my breakthrough..

chapters.title: Chapter 3634 - Hunted all the way
paragraphs: Hunted all the way
Translator: Henyee Translations , Editor. Henyee Translations
He San pursued him all the way.

He was one of the few prodigies of the younger generation of the Azure Dragon Empire. It could also be said that he was one of the most outstanding prodigies of this generation on the entire Moonlight Planet. Since he had made up his mind to kill Ling Han, he definitely wouldn’t give up so easily.
His repeated failures only strengthened his killing intent, and the pace of his pursuit did not slow down in the slightest.
Ling Han had to even choose a time to break through. He had to do it immediately after throwing He San off his tail. Otherwise, as time passed, the latter would definitely follow his tracks.
The opening of Hidden Apertures was extremely difficult, because the average person could only reach the level of 72 apertures, and reaching 108 apertures was already commendable.
“One hundred and eight is a minor cycle.
“Then, would the total number of apertures be 360, totalling to a complete
cycle?”
Ling Han gritted his teeth. He had spent close to a year to open all 108 apertures, so if he really opened all 360 apertures, wouldn’t that take another two years?
However, no matter how long it took, if there was a target of perfection, he had to achieve perfection.

Thus, it just so happened that there was such a super elite hunting him down, which could give him pressure on the line between life and death. He naturally did not want to miss out on such an opportunity.

Ling Han continued to fight monsters. Now, he was only missing the essence of Earth To say nothing of the fact that only He San was hunting him, even if a hundred He San joined forces, he would still stay here until he obtained the
Earth Element Crystal.
Seven days later, Ling Han suddenly experienced appreciation.
He stopped, and directly flopped onto the ground.
Boom! The elevation of the level of being began with such ferocity.
Ling Han ingested a Treasured Fruit of Life, then began to break through the shackles in his body.
Pa, pa, pa! One after another, the restrictions crumbled, and one aperture quietly opened. It could communicate with the heaven and earth, and could allow the mystical power to surge.
The first of the Hidden Apertures!
This was only the beginning. Not too long after, the second Hidden Aperture also opened, and then the third, advancing like a hot knife through butter.
Half an hour later, he had already opened nine Hidden Apertures. When he thought that this breakthrough was about to end, he discovered that the leap in level of being was still extremely turbulent.
He could continue?
Ling Han naturally wouldn’t stop. After ingesting another Treasured Fruit of
Life, his breakthrough was still ongoing.
The tenth Hidden Aperture, the eleventh Hidden Aperture... after opening nine more Hidden Apertures, the breakthrough finally stopped.
Ling Han was astonished. He had actually unlocked eighteen apertures this time?
Going by that logic, he would probably only need about half a year’s time, and would be able to open all the apertures of a complete cycle in his body.
Of course, that was if there were a total of 360 major apertures.
Weng, a terrifying killing intent blazed.
He San was here again!
This time, Ling Han didn’t flee. Instead, he faced him head-on. Moreover, his first move was the Three Styles of the God of War.
He had unlocked several Hidden Apertures. Had his battle prowess soared?
Hong! Hong! Hong!
After exchanging three moves, Ling Han turned around and fled. He unleashed Imminent Skyline and rapidly fled into the distance.

He was still no match for He San. Though he had unlocked a few Hidden Apertures, and his abilities had improved, there was no qualitative change in his abilities. Thus, after three moves, Ling Han fled.

-At this moment, He San was naturally very depressed. Ling Han, who had been running off the moment he saw him, actually dared to make a move? Furthermore, if you want to fight, so be it. Why had you only exchanged three moves?
These three moves stunned him slightly. The Three Styles of the God of War was too powerful, completely suppressing him. However, just as he was about to counterattack, Ling Han fled.
You actually f ran away!
He was filled with anger, and with a battle cry, he once again began his pursuit.

The chase was still ongoing, and Ling Han didn’t flee once he was caught up to. instead, he used the Three Styles of the God of War to counterattack. He would first exchange three moves, then use the Imminent Skyhne to flee.
After a few times, the anger that He San had accumulated was already off the charts.
Was there anyone like you?

From the very beginning, he had used three powerful moves, blasting him so hard that he could only defend passively, and when he was about to begin his counterattack, Ling Han ran off again, making him unable to use his full power and unable to vent his anger.
Damn it, how infuriating.
10 days later, Ling Han broke through again. He opened another 18 Hidden Apertures.
This time, he exchanged another three moves with He San. He felt that his abilities had improved again, but he was still no match for He San.
-Without a qualitative change, he should not be able to get the upper hand. Revenge was a dish best served cold. Moreover, he didn’t need to serve it too cold at that.

There was more and more essence of Earth in his possession, but being hunted down by He San like this, he did not consider reuniting with the babies, because once his relationship with the babies was exposed, the seven babies could possibly become factors that He San would use to threaten him.
He naturally wouldn’t place his children in danger. He didn’t even go to meet Shen Hanyun. Instead, he left a message at the agreed-upon meeting place, briefly explaining the situation.
Ten days, one month, three months!
Time continued to pass. He San’s willpower was astonishing, and he continued to follow behind Ling Han. It was as if he wouldn’t leave this place until he killed Ling Han.
Ling Han was also filled with anger at this. They were complete strangers, yet he had actually pursued him for half a year?
Was there such a great enmity between them?
just you wait, when he has advanced into the Mystery Realm Tier, we’ll call all debts in.
Though Ling Han was displeased, He San did not seem to be any better off either.

It should be known that when the two of them encountered each other afterwards, it was Ling Han who had used the Three Styles of the God of War to launch an attack, forcing him to only be able to protect himself at the beginning. Then, after the three moves, he would flee.

This was just like how a woman in a brothel would receive guests, but in the end she would encounter someone who was too fast. She had not gotten enough of the fun yet, and the latter actually did not pay even after he was done playing. He simply grabbed his pants and fled.

He was getting angrier and angrier, determined to crush Ling Han into dust. After so many days, Ling Han’s strength had also steadily increased. The number of apertures he had opened had already reached as many as 324.
He was very confident that the total number of apertures should be 360, which was just the number for a complete cycle.
■Soon, soon,’ he thought.

He now broke through about once every ten days, and opened eighteen Hidden Apertures. Going by that calculation, he would only need to break through two more times, and he would be able to reach the pinnacle of Enlightenment Tier. It had to be admitted that He San had a lot of credit for this. Without him coercing Ling Han like this, giving Ling Han enough motivation, it was definitely impossible for him to reach such heights in such a short period of time.

Just as he was thinking this, He San appeared again. This time, he directly struck out with his sword. He did not want to repeat the fate of being ruthlessly attacked by Ling Han right from the get go.
However, it was useless.
The moment Ling Han’s Three Styles of the God of War appeared, it immediately forced He San to defend with all his might.
However, when He San caught his breath, Ling Han had already used Imminent Skyline and disappeared.

He San couldn’t help but feel an urge rise up in him. Why not just forget about it? It was practically impossible to kill Ling Han here, so he had best stand guard outside. At that time, with his Cauldron Forging Tier strength, wouldn’t killing Ling Han be a piece of cake?

However, he immediately shook his head. If he submitted to such thoughts, it would definitely leave a flaw in his mind. In future, if he wanted to break through to the peak stage of martial arts, there would be hidden dangers.
He gave chase, and continued his pursuit..

chapters.title: Chapter 3635 - Battle of Willpower
paragraphs: Battle of Willpower
Translator: Henyee Translations ] Editor: Henyee Translations

He San pursued him all the way. This time, he spared no expense. It seemed like he had used some kind of secret technique. Ling Han was completely unable to throw him off his tail. At most, he would be able to immediately catch up to him in half an hour.
It was as if He San had also realized that though Ling Han had always been no match for him, his battle prowess was steadily increasing.
This was too terrifying, wasn’t it? If the other party was allowed to grow endlessly like that, wouldn’t he be able to stand shoulder to shoulder with him?
Though the other’s strength was still far inferior, there would eventually come a day like this.
Thus, he also became ruthless, determined to kill Ling Han.

Ling Han naturally didn’t have the time to fight monsters anymore. Moreover, he probably didn’t need them anymore. With the seven kids and Shen Hanyun, he definitely had enough essence of Earth. He only needed to fuse them together to form an Earth Element Crystal.

Under He San’s forceful suppression, Ling Han didn’t even have the time to cultivate his mystical power. His physical power was still fine, and his recovery ability was strong, so he didn’t have to worry about exhausting it at all. However, it was a different story for his mystical power.
Now, he was only expending it and not replenishing it.. If he only relied on ingesting some alchemical pills, how could they compensate for his expenditure?

In these two days, Ling Han’s condition had become extremely poor. Even if he had opened up his meridians far wider than the average person, he still couldn’t bear such expenditure. Thankfully, he was a Grandmaster Alchemist, and the effects of the alchemical pill that he concocted were far better than the alchemical pills concocted by an ordinary alchemist, and that was why he could continue to hold on.
However, he couldn’t bear it, and He San didn’t seem to be any better.
Why hadn’t he used this secret technique before?

It was precisely because he had expended too much energy that he had not used it all this while. Now, he had made his decision. He would kill Ling Han at all costs, but that did not mean that his expenditure would suddenly decrease.
After channeling for two consecutive days, he had almost reached his limit. His body was covered in sweat, and even his hair was sticking together. He was no longer as carefree as before.
Now, rather than calling it a contest of battle prowess between the two of them, it would be better to call it a test of willpower.
They were both close to reaching the limits of their physical bodies. Whoever could last longer would be able to grasp an advantage.

He San truly deserved the name of a supreme prodigy. His willpower was incredibly strong, and he continued to pursue Ling Han relentlessly. He believed that he would definitely be able to last longer than Ling Han.
And in terms of willpower, who had Ling Han feared before?
Five days, seven days, nine days!
On the tenth day, the two of them had actually reached their limits. It was clear that the other was right ahead of them, but they still had to take a few breaths before they could rush over.
At this time, the toughness of Ling Han’s physique showed its effects.
Although his mystical power was close to drying up, and he could only squeeze out a little bit of it from alchemical pills, his physical power was still abundant.
At least, he still retained 30% of his power.
He was preparing to counterattack. As long as He San’s mystical power was expended completely, then if they both used their physical power, he could insta-kill He San 10,000 times.
It was about time.
Ling Han suddenly stopped, turned around, and stared at He San.
“You’re not running anymore?” He San asked, panting heavily, trying his best
to keep his tone as normal as possible.
Ling Han smiled faintly, “Haven’t you always wanted to spar with me? I’ll oblige you!”
He strode forwards, and charged towards He San.
“Humph, do you think I don’t know what you’re thinking?” He San sneered. He delivered a palm strike, and a resplendent light flickered.
He had retained some power.
“Go!” Ling Han waved his hand, and xiu, Heavenly Pattern Jade flew out.
His stance of wanting to fight He San head-on was simply a pretense. The true killer move was the Heavenly Pattern Jade.
The Heavenly Pattern Jade instantly soared to ten times the speed of sound.
It couldn’t be helped. Ling Han’s mystical power had expended too much, so the might of this attack was also considerably inferior.

“Spiritual Power Spirit Tool?” He San was startled, but he immediately recognized it. His expression changed drastically, and he hurriedly dodged. However, if he had dodged at the first instant, he might have been able to dodge, but to dodge when the Heavenly Pattern Jade had already smashed out?
It was too late!
After all, he wasn’t in his prime right now. Even ten times the speed of sound was enough to kill him.
Peng, the Heavenly Pattern Jade hit He San, but circles of golden seals surged out from He San’s body, turning into something like a golden bell, protecting him within.

A pained expression instantly appeared on He San’s face. This was a Talisman Weapon that he had been bestowed with by an elite of his Sect. When he suffered an irresolvable attack, it would automatically activate. It was a treasure that could save his life.

This had already been used three times when he had ventured into ancient sites, and had also saved his life three times. He had never thought that when he was hunting down a Mystery Realm Tier cultivator, he would actually use it again.

However, this didn’t matter. He could obtain a Spiritual Power Spirit Tool. In the long term, it was definitely no less important than Talisman Weapon. Ling Han was also surprised. He had not thought that He San would actually have such a life-saving item.
Again!

He gave it his all as well. He activated the Imminent Skyline and charged towards He San. At the same time, he also stimulated the Destructive Energy. Not only did it wrap around his hands, the 300 plus apertures in his body also shot out at the same time.
He was like a porcupine now.
Peng! He crashed over.. This human cannonball was even faster than Heavenly Pattern Jade. He San naturally couldn’t dodge it, and he was instantly hit head-on.

If he was still in his prime condition, then with his battle prowess and the strength of Ling Han, the counterattack he launched would be enough to severely injure or even kill Ling Han, but now, he was sent flying from the impact, and the Destructive Energy was madly stabbing towards him. Weng, another circle of golden seals flickered, turning into a golden bell that protected He San.
‘F*ck! There’s more!’
Ling Han couldn’t help but curse. His mystical power was already exhausted, and he couldn’t use the Imminent Skyline again.

However, He San’s scalp became even more numb. Now that he had used up another chance to save his life, the Talisman Weapon’s energy was completely exhausted, and it turned into dust, no longer able to protect him.

He was extremely depressed. He had really gone out for wool and come back shorn. Not only had he not managed to kill Ling Han and snatch the Spiritual Power Spirit Tool, he had instead expended two life-saving chances. However, he turned around and fled without hesitation. If Ling Han unleashed another set of attacks like that, he definitely wouldn’t be able to withstand it.
It could not be helped. His present state was too poor.
Ling Han didn’t give chase. He couldn’t chase him at all.
Pa, he flopped onto the ground, and hurriedly took out alchemical pills which he ingested madly.

However, he had ingested too many alchemical pills these past few days, and a powerful immunity had developed in his body. The effects were minimal. Fortunately, he didn’t encounter any enemies. On the second day, when the sun rose, Ling Han hurriedly cultivated his mystical power and recovered it.
Half an hour later, Ling Han felt refreshed, and returned to his prime condition.
However, he had recovered, and He San was probably just about recovered as well. Later, he would definitely charge over to find him.
He was just about to stand up, when his expression changed drastically. F***, he was actually about to break through. The leap in level of being was already surging towards him.
Should he immediately break through, or suppress his cultivation for the moment?

Ling Han pondered for a moment before deciding to break through. If he advanced another step further, he would reach the peak stage of the Enlightenment Tier, and he would be able to break through to Mystery Realm Tier. Moreover, once he advanced into the Mystery Realm Tier, would he still need to fear He San?

Ling Han broke through. Boom, the shackles in his body were instantly shattered, one after another. The great battle of these ten days had completely squeezed out all his potential, allowing him to welcome the present burst of power.
But right at this moment, an oppressive coldness approached. The lingering He San had come again..

This had already been used three times when he had ventured into ancient sites, and had also saved his life three times.
He had never thought that when he was hunting down a Mystery Realm Tier cultivator, he would actually use it again.
However, this didn’t matter.
He could obtain a Spiritual Power Spirit Tool.
In the long term, it was definitely no less important than Talisman Weapon.
Ling Han was also surprised.
He had not thought that He San would actually have such a life-saving item.
Again!
He gave it his all as well.
He activated the Imminent Skyline and charged towards He San.
At the same time, he also stimulated the Destructive Energy.
Not only did it wrap around his hands, the 300 plus apertures in his body also shot out at the same time.
He was like a porcupine now.
Peng!
He crashed over..
This human cannonball was even faster than Heavenly Pattern Jade.
He San naturally couldn’t dodge it, and he was instantly hit head-on.

If he was still in his prime condition, then with his battle prowess and the strength of Ling Han, the counterattack he launched would be enough to severely injure or even kill Ling Han, but now, he was sent flying from the impact, and the Destructive Energy was madly stabbing towards him.
Weng, another circle of golden seals flickered, turning into a golden bell that protected He San.
‘F*ck!
There’s more!’
Ling Han couldn’t help but curse.
His mystical power was already exhausted, and he couldn’t use the Imminent Skyline again.
However, He San’s scalp became even more numb.
Now that he had used up another chance to save his life, the Talisman Weapon’s energy was completely exhausted, and it turned into dust, no longer able to protect him.
He was extremely depressed.
He had really gone out for wool and come back shorn.
Not only had he not managed to kill Ling Han and snatch the Spiritual Power Spirit Tool, he had instead expended two life-saving chances.
However, he turned around and fled without hesitation.
If Ling Han unleashed another set of attacks like that, he definitely wouldn’t be able to withstand it.
It could not be helped.
His present state was too poor.
Ling Han didn’t give chase.
He couldn’t chase him at all.
Pa, he flopped onto the ground, and hurriedly took out alchemical pills which he ingested madly.
However, he had ingested too many alchemical pills these past few days, and a powerful immunity had developed in his body.
The effects were minimal.
Fortunately, he didn’t encounter any enemies.
On the second day, when the sun rose, Ling Han hurriedly cultivated his mystical power and recovered it.
Half an hour later, Ling Han felt refreshed, and returned to his prime condition.
However, he had recovered, and He San was probably just about recovered as well.
Later, he would definitely charge over to find him.
He was just about to stand up, when his expression changed drastically.
F***, he was actually about to break through.
The leap in level of being was already surging towards him.
Should he immediately break through, or suppress his cultivation for the moment?
Ling Han pondered for a moment before deciding to break through.
If he advanced another step further, he would reach the peak stage of the Enlightenment Tier, and he would be able to break through to Mystery Realm Tier.
Moreover, once he advanced into the Mystery Realm Tier, would he still need to fear He San?
Ling Han broke through.
Boom, the shackles in his body were instantly shattered, one after another.
The great battle of these ten days had completely squeezed out all his potential, allowing him to welcome the present burst of power.
But right at this moment, an oppressive coldness approached.
The lingering He San had come again..

chapters.title: Chapter 3636 - Careless
paragraphs: Careless
Translator. Henyee Translations1Editor: Henyee Translations
He San would definitely not spare Ling Han.

In terms of reputation, since he said he wanted to kill Ling Han, he definitely had to do it. Otherwise, wouldn’t that ruin his reputation as the strongest of the younger generation of the Azure Dragon Empire?

From a profitable point of view, Ling Han had mastered many astonishing precious techniques, as well as Spiritual Power Spirit Tools like the Heavenly Pattern Jade. He naturally wanted to obtain this, and this would have to be done by killing Ling Han first.
Added with the fact that he had also expended two life-saving chances on Ling Han, this naturally made him want to take Ling Han down even more.
Otherwise, it would be too much of a loss for him.
Thus, after he recovered, he immediately ran back.
“Die!” He San attacked with his sword, and Sword Qi exploded. Xiu, xiu, xiu, the whole sky was filled with Sword Qi, like a rainstorm.
Without any hesitation, Ling Han immediately turned around and fled.
He was at a crucial moment of breaking through, so how could he have the time to fight He San?
Xiu, xiu, xiu! He used the Imminent Skyline a few times in a row, and under the violent tremors, his body instantly boiled.

Originally, he could have withstood it, but now that he was breaking through, his body was undergoing an earth-shattering change in the first place. With such an impact, he instantly felt extremely terrible, and spat out a mouthful of blood.
Again!
Ling Han’s expression revealed a hint of madness. Instead, he used this kind of shockwave to break through the Hidden Apertures. Pa, he actually succeeded. One of the apertures suddenly opened up.
Very good, there were still fifteen left.

But right at this moment, He San had already caught up. “Motherf*cker, who’s afraid of who!” Ling Han didn’t flee. He couldn’t use the Imminent Skyline for the time being, and he had no way to flee either. He charged at He San, activating the Three Styles of the God of War.

Faced with this three styles of celestial technique, although He San had suffered countless times, he was still unable to suppress it. He could only retreat continuously, not daring to face it head-on.
One Style, two Styles, three Styles, and finally, three Styles had passed.
Yet He San was taken aback. Why was Ling Han fighting so slowly this time?
“Not good!” Realization suddenly dawned on him. He had been tricked.
Unfortunately, his reaction was too slow.
Ling Han used Imminent Skyline and instantly left.
The reason why he channelled the Three Styles of the God of War extremely slowly was to stabilize the boiling in his body, so that he could once again use the Imminent Skyline.
“Pu!”

Ling Han spat out another mouthful of blood. Though he had delayed for a while, whether it was Imminent Skyline or the Three Styles of the God of War, they both placed a huge burden on his body, so how could he possibly truly recover?
However, at this moment, he became even more frenzied, and his eyes had already turned blood red.
“Open! Open! Open! Open!” he roared.
Pa, pa, several more shackles in his body were broken through consecutively, and he had also opened two apertures in a single go.
There were another... thirteen apertures to go.
In just a short while, He San came again.
He was like a lingering ghost!

Ling Han sighed internally. If He San was really a lingering ghost, that would be great. He could use the Six Characters Bright King Curse to force him to retreat. Without hesitation, he rushed forwards again, pulling out the stance of the Three Styles of the God of War.
‘Do you f*cking know any other moves?’
He San mocked internally, as he hurriedly retreated.
However, he discovered that Ling Han hadn’t used the Three Styles of the God
of War at all. He had only put on an act.
He had been tricked.
He San called out internally. True, Ling Han had just used the Three Styles of the God of War, so how could he possibly channel it a second time so quickly?
He flew into a humiliated rage, and hurriedly charged towards Ling Han. Ling Han humphed, and drew out the shard of the tombstone, which he threw at He San.
Boom, this brick was instantly enshrouded in layers of Yin Qi, as if there were vengeful ghosts that would not disperse.
F***, why had it mutated?

Ling Han was also taken aback. He hadn’t used the fragment of the tombstone since he came to the Moonlight Planet, nor had he taken it out. Who would’ve thought that there would be such a huge change?
Could it be that it was possible that the tomb was buried here, and the shard had been stolen from here, and that was why it had mutated?
Yin Qi soared sky-high, an astonishing sight.

He San’s expression also changed drastically. He hurriedly ran back, and only when he had ran out of the area covered by Yin Qi, did he stop. He looked at Ling Han, and said, “You are really seeking death. You actually dare to use something with such dense Yin Qi!”
“Now, there is no need for me to move. You would be enshrouded in Yin Qi, and die without any illness.”

This wasn’t an exaggeration. After being struck by the “brick”, anyone would be embroiled in misfortune and be extremely unlucky. Even Hong Tianbu, who had great fortune, couldn’t avoid it. He had been unlucky for a good few months.
At present, Ling Han was completely entwined in Yin Qi. Then, it would not be a matter of bad luck, but rather death.
“Then you can just wait slowly!” Ling Han completely ignored the Yin Qi, and began to break through again.
Pa, pa, pa! The shackles in his body shattered one after another, and the Hidden Apertures were also rapidly opening one after another.
Five, seven, nine... fifteen!
There were only three left.
However, at this time, Ling Han’s advancement slowed down, as if he was powerless to continue.
This was obviously because he had been disturbed by He San, and had not been able to focus on breaking through, which led to such consequences.
Ling Han didn’t know if he would still have the chance to open the remaining three apertures after missing this opportunity. Thus, he definitely had to “revive”.
Break!
He stimulated the dimensions in his body, and millions and millions of living beings released their Spiritual Power at the same time, forming a driving force.
Pa, the sixteenth aperture opened... After a while, pa, the seventeenth aperture opened.
There was only one left.
But even if Ling Han was already working so hard, there would eventually come a time when manpower was exhausted. His life force was beginning to decline, and his breakthrough was about to end.
No way!
A frenzied expression appeared on Ling Han’s face. He opened his mouth, and took the initiative to absorb the Yin Qi.
He needed energy now, and he needed help. Who cared what it was? It was fine as long as it could help him push open another aperture.
“Idiot!” He San shook his head. He had really never seen such an idiot. Was he complaining that he was not dying fast enough?
However, after the Yin Qi was stimulated like this, it became increasingly violent, boiling like boiling water. Even He San could not see clearly. All he could see was a lifeless black gas.
Yin Qi entered his body, and Ling Han shivered. This was not just the coldness of his body, but also a kind of desolation in his soul, making him feel as if he was about to die.
Break!
Yet Ling Han did not care, and stimulated this energy, once again activating the leap in level of being that was about to calm down.
Boom, he had randomly messed around, and actually succeeded.
Pa, pa, pa! Another three shackles were shattered, and the eighteenth aperture was also penetrated.
A shocking scene appeared. All of Ling Han’s apertures lit up at the same time, like a sky filled with stars.

At this moment, it was as if he had cultivated some kind of Divine Physique, in just an instant, all the major apertures of a complete cycle had dimmed, and temporarily returned to being ordinary, just waiting to explode.
Boom! It was as if the heaven and earth had been enraged. Bursts of thunder rang out, and lightning flashed past, as if it wanted to kill a certain treasonous person.
No matter how heavy the Yin Qi was, it would not be able to withstand the fury of this heaven and earth. In an instant, all the Yin Qi had been dispersed.

He San finally saw Ling Han again, and couldn’t help but smirk coldly. Though this brat seemed to be very lucky, and even the heavens were helping him, it was already too late. He had absorbed too much Yin Qi, and even the air of death was exuding from him.
Was there still any hope for him?

chapters.title: Chapter 3637 - Wondrous Buddhist Race Technique
paragraphs: Wondrous Buddhist Race Technique
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations
“How foolish. You are seeking your own death.” He San waved his sleeve, though he was slightly puzzled.

Why had Ling Han not fled this time, but rather fought him to the death time and time again? Otherwise, Ling Han wouldn’t have needed to use that evil weapon with overflowing Yin Qi, causing him to be enshrouded in Yin Qi, and seek his own death.
Ling Han cracked a smile, and said, “What you think is just what you think.”
Was this a tongue twister?
He San did not make a move. By now, there was already no need for him to make a move. Ling Han’s body was enshrouded in Yin Qi, and the time of his death was drawing near.
Yet Ling Han stretched out a hand, and shouted at himself, “An!”
Boom, the Buddhist chant was vast and mighty, and thought-provoking.
The Six Characters Bright King Curse could suppress evil, and could kill evil spirits. It was used to subdue evil beasts and transcend dead souls.
As he spat out this word, a black-colored aura of death instantly surged out of Ling Han’s palm. Then, it turned into ash, as if it had been annihilated.
“This is a Buddhist Race technique to exorcise the dead!” He San blurted out, “You are a Buddhist Race being!”
‘F*ck you, you’re the one who is a bald monk!’
Ling Han thought, but ignored him completely. Instead, he continued to shout at his hands, “An!”
Boom, another ball of black Qi was forced out by him.
“An!” “An!” “An!” “An!” “An!”
As Ling Han continued to shout, puffs of black Qi were forced out and then annihilated.

The corner of He San’s mouth twitched slightly. Why was it that every time you fspeak, it was only the word “An”? Wasn’t the Six Characters Bright King Curse supposed to have six true words? What about the other five? Have you eaten them all?

In truth, Ling Han also wanted to use the complete Six Characters Bright King Curse; why was it six characters? That was definitely because it had to be used as a complete set to be able to maximize its might. If it was just ‘An’, the effects of expelling evil would definitely be limited.
But what could he do? He only knew the word ‘An’.
“An!” “An!” “An!” “An!”
He continued to shout.
‘An’ your sister!

He San couldn’t take it anymore. With a loud roar, he charged towards Ling Han. Now, the aura of death was all inside Ling Han’s body, and whatever was spat out would also be immediately annihilated. It could no longer injure him.
With a thought from Ling Han, the apertures of a complete cycle lit up at the same time, like the stars that filled the skies, forming a screen of light around his body.
Peng!
He San’s attack arrived, yet was blocked by the starlight.

“What?” He San faltered for a moment. What kind of freakish defense was this? It was too terrifying, wasn’t it? He roared loudly, and blue energy activated. It finally broke through the defense of the starlight screen, and continued to attack Ling Han.
However, there was enough time for Ling Han to retreat. He didn’t counterattack, and he simply shouted at himself, “An!”

The most important thing now was to expel the aura of death. This was fatal. He could already feel that the vitality of his internal organs had greatly decreased, and were presently depleting. If he did not quickly force it out, there would be a great problem.
He San gave chase again, but this time, Ling Han didn’t use the starlight screen. Instead, he used Imminent Skyline to retreat.
It wasn’t that Ling Han didn’t want to use it, but that after it was shattered, there was no way to reform it at the first instant, and there was a cooldown period.
Fortunately, it didn’t take long. When He San caught up again, Ling Han’s apertures of a complete cycle lit up again, forming a screen of starlight.
Peng!
He San’s attack arrived, yet was unable to penetrate through his defenses.
—He had to use blue-coloured energy, and only then would he be able to damage the light screen made up of stars.

That was a little like Destructive Energy, though it was slightly inferior in quality. However, it was still extraordinary. However, this was also the problem. This energy was too powerful, and it placed a heavy burden on He San, preventing him from channeling it for a long time.

Peng, peng, peng! There was no blue-coloured energy, and He San only managed to shatter the light screen after firing a total of seventeen times. However, this also gave Ling Han enough time to recover, and he once again used Imminent Skyline.
“An!” “An!” “An!” “An!”

The black Qi in his body was continuously expelled, and his condition was also improving. At first, his whole face was so dark that it could barely be seen, but now, not only had it returned to white, it had also become rosy.
Not too long after, he would be able to return to a state of perfection.
He San was extremely depressed. Why did Ling Han suddenly have an incomparably powerful defensive technique?
No, this definitely wasn’t an ordinary secret technique, but rather a Mystical Power. Otherwise, it definitely wouldn’t be so powerful.
But why hadn’t Ling Han cast it earlier?
Could it be that he had just mastered it?
To be hunted to the point of exhaustion, then explode, and awaken a Mystical Power?
He San really wanted to slap himself. If that was really the case, wasn’t he the most foolish person in the world?
“Die! Die! Die!” He brandished his sword, his eyes bloodshot, looking like he had gone mad.
After Ling Han shouted “An” a few more times, the aura of death in his body was completely expelled. He laughed loudly, “He San, we’ll call it a day. See how I beat you up the next time we meet!”

He channelled the Imminent Skyline consecutively, and after completely throwing He San off his tail, he then walked quickly. In this way, it would take He San at least half an hour to catch up to him.

Ling Han was filled with confidence. He had already unlocked the apertures of a complete cycle. Now, he only had to take another step further, and he would advance into the Mystery Realm Tier, and in a battle of equal cultivation levels, who would be a match for him?
He only needed a few days now.

Ling Han continued to cultivate the last step of this cultivation level. After his level of being had increased, his meridians could expand a little more. As long as he completed this step, he would be considered to have reached the true end of the Enlightenment Tier.
He San, just you wait.
Ling Han didn’t gather any more essence of Earth. There was only one thing he needed to do these few days, and that was to perfect his cultivation of Enlightenment Tier to perfection.
He tried his best to conceal his tracks, using the hide of the Void Beast to conceal himself. This was very effective. As expected, He San could no longer find him.

One day, two days, three days. Every morning, Ling Han would extract the power of heaven and earth from the heaven and earth, and his meridians would continuously expand, breaking through to the pinnacle level.

When he was cultivating, his own aura naturally could not be concealed, but it was only for half an hour. Even with good luck, He San had only caught up to him after Ling Han finished cultivating, and he had easily thrown him off his tail.
Nine days later, Ling Han couldn’t advance any further.

The meridians had already expanded to the extreme, and the major apertures of a complete cycle had also been completely opened—the appearance of the Starlight Screen made him realize that he had cultivated Enlightenment Tier to the extreme, and that was also how Mystical Powers like Eye Technique and Sword of Metal had appeared.
Which also meant that he had now cultivated Enlightenment Tier to perfection.
In that case, he would begin his attempt to break through to Mystery Realm Tier.
Theoretically speaking, Mystery Realm Tier wasn’t too difficult.
What was Mystery Realm Tier?
It was to find a Mystery Realm in his body, and use it to store mystical power. This would be the source of his future energy.

—If he still used his meridians as a storehouse for mystical power, then after he advanced into Celestial Path, wouldn’t the might of his attack be earth-shattering and instantly exhaust all his mystical power?
Then wouldn’t that mean that there was no meaning to the expansion of meridians?
Of course not. The wider the meridian network expanded, the stronger the power of the attack would naturally be.
In other words, the width of the meridian network determined the explosive power of the cultivator, and the size of the Mystery Realms determined the endurance of the cultivator.
Both were equally important..

That was definitely because it had to be used as a complete set to be able to maximize its might.
If it was just ‘An’, the effects of expelling evil would definitely be limited.
But what could he do?
He only knew the word ‘An’.
“An!” “An!” “An!” “An!”
He continued to shout.
‘An’ your sister!
He San couldn’t take it anymore.
With a loud roar, he charged towards Ling Han.
Now, the aura of death was all inside Ling Han’s body, and whatever was spat out would also be immediately annihilated.
It could no longer injure him.
With a thought from Ling Han, the apertures of a complete cycle lit up at the same time, like the stars that filled the skies, forming a screen of light around his body.
Peng!
He San’s attack arrived, yet was blocked by the starlight.
“What?” He San faltered for a moment.
What kind of freakish defense was this?
It was too terrifying, wasn’t it?
He roared loudly, and blue energy activated.
It finally broke through the defense of the starlight screen, and continued to attack Ling Han.
However, there was enough time for Ling Han to retreat.
He didn’t counterattack, and he simply shouted at himself, “An!”
The most important thing now was to expel the aura of death.
This was fatal.
He could already feel that the vitality of his internal organs had greatly decreased, and were presently depleting.
If he did not quickly force it out, there would be a great problem.
He San gave chase again, but this time, Ling Han didn’t use the starlight screen.
Instead, he used Imminent Skyline to retreat.
It wasn’t that Ling Han didn’t want to use it, but that after it was shattered, there was no way to reform it at the first instant, and there was a cooldown period.
Fortunately, it didn’t take long.
When He San caught up again, Ling Han’s apertures of a complete cycle lit up again, forming a screen of starlight.
Peng!
He San’s attack arrived, yet was unable to penetrate through his defenses.
—He had to use blue-coloured energy, and only then would he be able to damage the light screen made up of stars.
That was a little like Destructive Energy, though it was slightly inferior in quality.
However, it was still extraordinary.
However, this was also the problem.
This energy was too powerful, and it placed a heavy burden on He San, preventing him from channeling it for a long time.
Peng, peng, peng!
There was no blue-coloured energy, and He San only managed to shatter the light screen after firing a total of seventeen times.
However, this also gave Ling Han enough time to recover, and he once again used Imminent Skyline.
“An!” “An!” “An!” “An!”
The black Qi in his body was continuously expelled, and his condition was also improving.
At first, his whole face was so dark that it could barely be seen, but now, not only had it returned to white, it had also become rosy.
Not too long after, he would be able to return to a state of perfection.
He San was extremely depressed.
Why did Ling Han suddenly have an incomparably powerful defensive technique?
No, this definitely wasn’t an ordinary secret technique, but rather a Mystical Power.
Otherwise, it definitely wouldn’t be so powerful.
But why hadn’t Ling Han cast it earlier?
Could it be that he had just mastered it?
To be hunted to the point of exhaustion, then explode, and awaken a Mystical Power?
He San really wanted to slap himself.
If that was really the case, wasn’t he the most foolish person in the world?
“Die!
Die!
Die!” He brandished his sword, his eyes bloodshot, looking like he had gone mad.
After Ling Han shouted “An” a few more times, the aura of death in his body was completely expelled.
He laughed loudly, “He San, we’ll call it a day.
See how I beat you up the next time we meet!”
He channelled the Imminent Skyline consecutively, and after completely throwing He San off his tail, he then walked quickly.
In this way, it would take He San at least half an hour to catch up to him.
Ling Han was filled with confidence.
He had already unlocked the apertures of a complete cycle.
Now, he only had to take another step further, and he would advance into the Mystery Realm Tier, and in a battle of equal cultivation levels, who would be a match for him?
He only needed a few days now.
Ling Han continued to cultivate the last step of this cultivation level.
After his level of being had increased, his meridians could expand a little more.
As long as he completed this step, he would be considered to have reached the true end of the Enlightenment Tier.
He San, just you wait.
Ling Han didn’t gather any more essence of Earth.
There was only one thing he needed to do these few days, and that was to perfect his cultivation of Enlightenment Tier to perfection.
He tried his best to conceal his tracks, using the hide of the Void Beast to conceal himself.
This was very effective.
As expected, He San could no longer find him.
One day, two days, three days.
Every morning, Ling Han would extract the power of heaven and earth from the heaven and earth, and his meridians would continuously expand, breaking through to the pinnacle level.
When he was cultivating, his own aura naturally could not be concealed, but it was only for half an hour.
Even with good luck, He San had only caught up to him after Ling Han finished cultivating, and he had easily thrown him off his tail.
Nine days later, Ling Han couldn’t advance any further.

The meridians had already expanded to the extreme, and the major apertures of a complete cycle had also been completely opened—the appearance of the Starlight Screen made him realize that he had cultivated Enlightenment Tier to the extreme, and that was also how Mystical Powers like Eye Technique and Sword of Metal had appeared.
Which also meant that he had now cultivated Enlightenment Tier to perfection.
In that case, he would begin his attempt to break through to Mystery Realm Tier.
Theoretically speaking, Mystery Realm Tier wasn’t too difficult.
What was Mystery Realm Tier?
It was to find a Mystery Realm in his body, and use it to store mystical power.
This would be the source of his future energy.

—If he still used his meridians as a storehouse for mystical power, then after he advanced into Celestial Path, wouldn’t the might of his attack be earth-shattering and instantly exhaust all his mystical power?
Then wouldn’t that mean that there was no meaning to the expansion of meridians?
Of course not.
The wider the meridian network expanded, the stronger the power of the attack would naturally be.
In other words, the width of the meridian network determined the explosive power of the cultivator, and the size of the Mystery Realms determined the endurance of the cultivator.
Both were equally important..

chapters.title: Chapter 3638 - Ling Han’s Mystery Realm
paragraphs: Ling Han’s Mystery Realm
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations
Thus, Ling Han definitely had to choose carefully which part of his body it was better to develop into a Mystery Realm.
There was only one chance, and once it was decided, after breaking through into Mystery Realm Tier, his was something that couldn’t be changed. Was it the Dantian that the majority would choose?
Dantian was the Sea of Qi, and it could become an independent space, storing a large amount of mystical power. It was not a bad choice.
Or the mind, which could similarly be opened up into an independent space. Dantian?
Ling Han shook his head. This was the choice of the masses, and if he wanted to become the strongest, he definitely could not walk the path of the masses. Then what about his mind?
He couldn’t either. That was where his divine sense was located. If he placed his divine sense together with his mystical power, who knew what would happen.
But with these two options gone, what other choice did he have?
No matter which part it was, it was impossible to create an independent space, just like how the meridians in his body had a limited space.
Ling Han’s eyes lit up. He had already had an idea, but didn’t know if he could successfully execute it.
He had great ambitions. He wanted to cultivate to a height that there would never be a second person that could reach.
—Using the dimensions in his body as a Mystery Realm!
Just how many dimensions did he have in his body? And just how large was this space?
If he could develop all these dimensions into Mystery Realms, then he really wouldn’t have to worry about not having enough power to continue.
Who could compete with him?
Most importantly, this was a path that no one had ever walked before. He had to carefully explore it, and there was not the slightest precedent that he could learn from.
However, this was definitely the path of the strongest that he wanted to pursue, so Ling Han could not possibly shrink back.
“Come!”
He sat down in a cross-legged position. At present, he needed an absolutely quiet environment, because he did not know how much time he would need to complete his breakthrough.

Thankfully, he had the Void Beast hide wrapped around him. As long as he did not begin his true breakthrough, the heaven and earth would not resonate with him, so his aura naturally would not leak out. If He San found him again, that would definitely be him being extremely unlucky.

Ling Han calmly thought about transforming the dimensions in his body into Mystery Realms. This was only an idea, but as for how to implement it, it was definitely not something that could be done with mere thought.
He first simulated it, and after confirming that it could work, he finally began. Weng, the leap of level of being began, and Ling Han underwent the final great upgrade of the mortal level.
Next, though he could also break through the shackles, that was only cultivation of a minor level, and could not be compared to breaking through to a major tier.
It had begun.
Ling Han stimulated the dimensions in his body. He naturally chose the transcendent dimensions as the first to be opened to become Mystery Realms.

The dimensional passageway had long since formed, and this was a ready-made one. There was no need for Ling Han to construct it. However, the problem was how to open a passageway so that mystical power could circulate. Fortunately, Ling Han had done some experiments before, moving the living beings and objects out of his body. Though they were all crushed into dust by the power of heaven and earth of this world, it still allowed him to accumulate experience.

How he had come out in the past was how he was going to enter now. Furthermore, he had to open up a stable passageway. It was impossible that whenever he unleashed his might, he would have mystical power come out as if it was toothpaste. Then, what was the point of continuing the battle? Thus, to Ling Han, the key question was how to open this passageway. This sounded simple, but connecting the dimensions and meridians was definitely not something that could be done with just a few words.
Ling Han began to experiment, constructing a passageway. However, once the surging energy surged, this passageway was destroyed.
Again, it was still very quickly destroyed.
Again, again, again.
Ling Han made endless attempts. Though each attempt ended in failure, he could learn from it every time, improve and improve.
It was unknown how many times he had failed. When Ling Han was a little numb, a new passageway was constructed, and mystical power surged. Yi, there was no damage?
Ling Han also came to his senses after a while. He had initially planned to construct a new passageway.
Boom, it was as if the mystical power in the meridians had found its owner, and they all surged towards this transcendent dimension.

In the future, the meridian system would no longer be responsible for storing mystical power. It would only provide mystical power for the circulation of power. This would undoubtedly increase Ling Han’s battle prowess greatly. However, the improvement of level of being wasn’t over yet.
Ling Han continued to open a new passageway to communicate with the dimensions.
His speed was very fast, because this did not involve opening up a Mystery Realm, and he only needed to build bridges, right until he broke through to Celestial Path.
After such a long time, he had a very high chance of constructing a passageway for all the dimensions in his body, turning them into a storage for his mystical power.
The heaven and earth immediately sensed it again, and a large number of dark clouds gathered. Thunder rumbled, and lightning flashed closely.
Ling Han ignored it completely, and merely tried his best to construct a passageway in his body.
too, 1OOO, 10,000. Half a day passed, and Ling Han’s level of being finally stopped. Meanwhile, he had also constructed more than 73,000 passageways, connecting to the same number of dimensions.
In terms of the maximum amount of mystical power that could be stored he could probably compare to the level of mystical power of Sect Masters or even Venerate Tiers, right?

There was no end to Mystery Realm Tier. In the future, as the cultivation level increased, the space created could still continue to expand, but no matter how much it expanded, could it compare to a freak like Ling Han?
He could also expand his dimensions, transforming the low-level dimensions mto medium-level dimensions, high-level dimensions, and even transcendent dimensions.
Of course, the problem now was not increasing the level of dimensions, but rather how to fill up the existing dimensions.

Previously, the mystical power stored in his meridians couldn’t even fill the first dimension, making Ling Han feel extremely hungry. This naturally wasn’t because he wanted to eat, but because he needed to store more mystical power. He was sure that this feeling of hunger would accompany him for a very, very long time, because his Mystery Realms were really too, too big.
Moreover, as his level of being increased each time, he would construct more passageways, and his hunger would also increase.

Ai, Ling Han sighed. Others were worrying about the Mystery Realm not being big enough, but he was actually worried that the Mystery Realm was so big that It couldn’t be filled even when he rushed up to the Foundation Building Tier or even Cauldron Forging Tier. What kind of blissful worry was this?
“My current strength... has changed drastically!”
Ling Han stood up, and with a casual wave of his hands and feet, it was as if he could destroy the heavens and earth.
This was the ultimate power of a mortal.
As for He San?
Come, come, come. Let’s see how he will defeat this guy.
Ling Han wasn’t disappointed. Without the Void Beast hide to conceal his aura, He San quickly found him.
He looked coldly at Ling Han, his killing intent solidifying.
“Why aren’t you attacking or running?” he asked.
Previously, whenever Ling Han had been caught up to by him, he would either turn around and run, or he would rush up, fire three moves and run again. He had never been as calm as he was now.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and said, “I want to give you a good beating, so how can I run?”
“Hahahaha!” He San laughed loudly, “What a joke. If it was not for the fact that you have mastered a godly escape technique, you would have long since been buried half a year ago.”
“Come!” Ling Han crooked a finger at him.
In a battle of equal cultivation levels, he was invincible!
