chapters.title: Chapter 3639 - Crushed
paragraphs: Crushed
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations
He San was a little uncertain.
In his impression, Ling Han was definitely not the type to be forcefully stubborn. This person was incredibly slippery, and if he couldn’t win, he would run, without any hesitation at all.
Now, he did not run, nor did he use any tricks. He looked like he wanted to confront him head-on, which confused him.
Could it be that he was up to something?
“Do you really dare to fight me?” He San asked calmly.
“Today, I’ll make you kneel and admit defeat,” Ling Han said with a smile.
“Cheeky mouth!” He San humphed, and charged towards Ling Han. The longsword in his hand flew out in a slash.
The sword swept past, and Sword Qi soared into the skies.

It had to be admitted that He San was indeed very powerful. If he was still a Mystery Realm Tier, he would definitely be one of the top elites. He was a three-star genius. And now, he had been suppressed back to this level from Cauldron Forging Tier, so his battle prowess could only be stronger.
He was almost comparable to a four-star genius of Mystery Realm Tier, and that was enough to sweep aside all obstacles in this cultivation level.

The problem was that Ling Han had already surpassed a four-star genius. After opening 360 apertures, it was equivalent to him breaking through another limit, and advancing into Mystery Realm Tier on this basis, what level would his battle prowess reach?
Ling Han stepped forwards, his iron fists swinging out, enshrouded in the power of Metal.
Peng!

The fist crashed into the sword, and instantly, a massive ball of light burst out. It was like a meteor had crashed into it, creating a massive explosion, and a figure was sent flying out of the explosion even faster than the transmission of energy.
It was He San.
This wasn’t the first time he had been sent flying by Ling Han. He had faced the Three Styles of the God of War head-on, and the result was that he had been sent flying.
But that would have to be the Three Styles of the God of War. With all his might, Ling Han could only channel the Three Styles of the God of War once, and could not possibly use it consecutively.
But now, Ling Han had only thrown a simple punch.
Peng, He San fell onto the ground. He immediately got back to his feet. He was not injured, but the expression on his face was as if he had seen a ghost.
He was actually no match for the power of Ling Han’s punch?
That wasn’t the Three Styles of the God of War.
How was this possible!
“What’s impossible?” Ling Han said calmly. “In a battle of equals, I’m invincible!”

He San couldn’t figure out why Ling Han had suddenly become so much stronger. This was completely illogical! Even if Ling Han had advanced into Celestial Path, he would still be suppressed by the heaven and earth here, and once again be struck down to Mystery Realm Tier.
This battle prowess would still increase, but it would definitely be limited, and would not be too exaggerated.
However, now that Ling Han’s battle prowess had increased, it was more than ten times stronger than before.
This was completely unrealistic.
“Are you shocked? Are you surprised?” With a tap of Ling Han’s foot, he had already caught up to He San, and shot out another punch.

He San sent out a palm strike in response, but the moment the fist and palm came into contact, he was sent flying. He was like a child that was clashing head-on with a sturdy man. The gap was incredibly wide.
Ling Han chased after him again, his iron fists striking out continuously.
Peng, peng, peng! He San could only stay on the defensive, continuously retreating and being sent flying.

“Heaven Shadow Sword!” He San roared loudly. As the sword swept past, blue-coloured energy surged, forming a frightening destructive power. Finally, Ling Han was forced back a single step, and he was able to catch his breath.
He used his sword to support himself, breathing heavily.
How was this possible? How was this possible?

Now that he had used his ultimate move, he was actually only able to force Ling Han to stop for a short while? Just like how Ling Han had used the Three Styles of the God of War previously, he looked mighty on the surface, but in truth, he was only strong on the outside but weak on the inside.
A thought suddenly occurred to him, and he exclaimed in shock, “You have indeed broken through, but it is not Celestial Path that you have broken through, but rather Mystery Realm Tier!”
Now, everything could be explained.
Ling Han couldn’t help but scoff, “You finally realized?”
He San was speechless. Only now did he know that Ling Han wasn’t boasting at all when he said that he was invincible among his peers, but rather he was really that powerful.
Even if Ling Han had clearly explained at that time, he would definitely not have believed that Ling Han could just barely stand against him when he was only in the Enlightenment Tier.
There was someone in this world that was more freakish than him, and had surpassed him by so much at that? Wasn’t that a joke?
But now, there was no need for Ling Han to say anything. He had realized it on his own.
This really was a supreme freak.
Were they still going to fight?

He San didn’t think that he had any chance of winning. In the Enlightenment Tier, Ling Han was almost capable of contending against him, and now, he had advanced to a new level, and his abilities had undergone an earth-shattering leap.

Get out, get out of this place. He was in the Cauldron Forging Tier, so no matter how freakish Ling Han was, so what? As long as there was no restriction from heaven and earth, even if Ling Han was a 10-star prodigy, he would still be able to suppress Ling Han with a single finger.
With this in mind, he instantly decided to retreat.
“You want to leave? That’s impossible.” Ling Han shook his head. If you had made up your mind to flee early on, it would have been fine. Now that you’re right at my doorstep, you still want to leave?
Hehe.
“I admit that your natural talent can also be ranked in the upper echelons of the universe, but if you want to detain me—”
Peng!
He San was just about to say a few words to keep up appearances. He could not allow his prestige to be weakened, but he had not even finished his words, when he was sent flying.

Ling Han turned his neck and exercised his shoulders. Just now, it was he who had sent He San flying with Imminent Skyline. With how tough his physique was, this kind of collision was completely no big deal.
But He San was in trouble.
With how fast the Imminent Skyline was, even if Ling Han’s own weight was only over 50kg, the destructive power of such a high-speed collision was still incredibly terrifying.
At least two of his bones had been broken, and his face was extremely pale.
He San’s face was filled with fury. He had never been treated like this before. He had not even finished his words, when he was interrupted, and in such a crude manner at that.
But... there was nothing he could do.
Though this method was simple and violent, its might was extremely domineering, and that was to use brute strength to crush and forcefully take advantage of its opponent.
He San roared in fury, and brandished his sword in attack.
Ling Han raised his fist and threw a punch.
Under the overwhelming power, the sword in He San’s hand instantly slipped out of his grip.
He retreated continuously, while blood continued to drip from his right hand. That attack just now had caused the web between his thumb and forefinger to split open.
Ling Han strode forwards. He opened up the major apertures of a complete cycle, forming the very brilliant Starlight Screen.
He San appeared slightly despondent, “How could you possibly be so powerful? This is impossible! This is impossible!”

Although he understood that Ling Han’s breakthrough this time was into Mystery Realm Tier, causing his battle prowess to soar, he still couldn’t understand how a Mystery Realm Tier could be as strong as this.
Was this a four-star genius?

No, he was now comparable to a four-star genius of Mystery Realm Tier. Even if he was slightly inferior, he wouldn’t be too far off. A four-star genius definitely wouldn’t be able to thrash him so easily.
Five, five-star genius!

He was extremely jealous. To say nothing of a five-star genius, even four-star geniuses only existed in legends. He, a three-star genius, could never hope to catch up, yet now he actually discovered that he had actually encountered a five-star genius.
“Nothing is impossible!” Ling Han threw a punch. He didn’t need to use any secret technique at all, and one punch was enough.
Peng!
He San tried his best to disperse it. He had used a powerful move, but the result was only just neutralizing it.
His powerful move was actually only capable of dispersing a casual punch from the other?
“Who in the world are you?” He San asked through gritted teeth. “You’re definitely not from Moonlight Planet.. There’s definitely no such person as you!”

In his impression, Ling Han was definitely not the type to be forcefully stubborn.
This person was incredibly slippery, and if he couldn’t win, he would run, without any hesitation at all.
Now, he did not run, nor did he use any tricks.
He looked like he wanted to confront him head-on, which confused him.
Could it be that he was up to something?
“Do you really dare to fight me?” He San asked calmly.
“Today, I’ll make you kneel and admit defeat,” Ling Han said with a smile.
“Cheeky mouth!” He San humphed, and charged towards Ling Han.
The longsword in his hand flew out in a slash.
The sword swept past, and Sword Qi soared into the skies.
It had to be admitted that He San was indeed very powerful.
If he was still a Mystery Realm Tier, he would definitely be one of the top elites.
He was a three-star genius.
And now, he had been suppressed back to this level from Cauldron Forging Tier, so his battle prowess could only be stronger.
He was almost comparable to a four-star genius of Mystery Realm Tier, and that was enough to sweep aside all obstacles in this cultivation level.
The problem was that Ling Han had already surpassed a four-star genius.
After opening 360 apertures, it was equivalent to him breaking through another limit, and advancing into Mystery Realm Tier on this basis, what level would his battle prowess reach?
Ling Han stepped forwards, his iron fists swinging out, enshrouded in the power of Metal.
Peng!
The fist crashed into the sword, and instantly, a massive ball of light burst out.
It was like a meteor had crashed into it, creating a massive explosion, and a figure was sent flying out of the explosion even faster than the transmission of energy.
It was He San.
This wasn’t the first time he had been sent flying by Ling Han.
He had faced the Three Styles of the God of War head-on, and the result was that he had been sent flying.
But that would have to be the Three Styles of the God of War.
With all his might, Ling Han could only channel the Three Styles of the God of War once, and could not possibly use it consecutively.
But now, Ling Han had only thrown a simple punch.
Peng, He San fell onto the ground.
He immediately got back to his feet.
He was not injured, but the expression on his face was as if he had seen a ghost.
He was actually no match for the power of Ling Han’s punch?
That wasn’t the Three Styles of the God of War.
How was this possible!
“What’s impossible?” Ling Han said calmly.
“In a battle of equals, I’m invincible!”
He San couldn’t figure out why Ling Han had suddenly become so much stronger.
This was completely illogical!
Even if Ling Han had advanced into Celestial Path, he would still be suppressed by the heaven and earth here, and once again be struck down to Mystery Realm Tier.
This battle prowess would still increase, but it would definitely be limited, and would not be too exaggerated.
However, now that Ling Han’s battle prowess had increased, it was more than ten times stronger than before.
This was completely unrealistic.
“Are you shocked?
Are you surprised?” With a tap of Ling Han’s foot, he had already caught up to He San, and shot out another punch.
He San sent out a palm strike in response, but the moment the fist and palm came into contact, he was sent flying.
He was like a child that was clashing head-on with a sturdy man.
The gap was incredibly wide.
Ling Han chased after him again, his iron fists striking out continuously.
Peng, peng, peng!
He San could only stay on the defensive, continuously retreating and being sent flying.
“Heaven Shadow Sword!” He San roared loudly.
As the sword swept past, blue-coloured energy surged, forming a frightening destructive power.
Finally, Ling Han was forced back a single step, and he was able to catch his breath.
He used his sword to support himself, breathing heavily.
How was this possible?
How was this possible?
Now that he had used his ultimate move, he was actually only able to force Ling Han to stop for a short while?
Just like how Ling Han had used the Three Styles of the God of War previously, he looked mighty on the surface, but in truth, he was only strong on the outside but weak on the inside.
A thought suddenly occurred to him, and he exclaimed in shock, “You have indeed broken through, but it is not Celestial Path that you have broken through, but rather Mystery Realm Tier!”
Now, everything could be explained.
Ling Han couldn’t help but scoff, “You finally realized?”
He San was speechless.
Only now did he know that Ling Han wasn’t boasting at all when he said that he was invincible among his peers, but rather he was really that powerful.
Even if Ling Han had clearly explained at that time, he would definitely not have believed that Ling Han could just barely stand against him when he was only in the Enlightenment Tier.
There was someone in this world that was more freakish than him, and had surpassed him by so much at that?
Wasn’t that a joke?
But now, there was no need for Ling Han to say anything.
He had realized it on his own.
This really was a supreme freak.
Were they still going to fight?
He San didn’t think that he had any chance of winning.
In the Enlightenment Tier, Ling Han was almost capable of contending against him, and now, he had advanced to a new level, and his abilities had undergone an earth-shattering leap.
Get out, get out of this place.
He was in the Cauldron Forging Tier, so no matter how freakish Ling Han was, so what?
As long as there was no restriction from heaven and earth, even if Ling Han was a 10-star prodigy, he would still be able to suppress Ling Han with a single finger.
With this in mind, he instantly decided to retreat.
“You want to leave?
That’s impossible.” Ling Han shook his head.
If you had made up your mind to flee early on, it would have been fine.
Now that you’re right at my doorstep, you still want to leave?
Hehe.
“I admit that your natural talent can also be ranked in the upper echelons of the universe, but if you want to detain me—”
Peng!
He San was just about to say a few words to keep up appearances.
He could not allow his prestige to be weakened, but he had not even finished his words, when he was sent flying.
Ling Han turned his neck and exercised his shoulders.
Just now, it was he who had sent He San flying with Imminent Skyline.
With how tough his physique was, this kind of collision was completely no big deal.
But He San was in trouble.
With how fast the Imminent Skyline was, even if Ling Han’s own weight was only over 50kg, the destructive power of such a high-speed collision was still incredibly terrifying.
At least two of his bones had been broken, and his face was extremely pale.
He San’s face was filled with fury.
He had never been treated like this before.
He had not even finished his words, when he was interrupted, and in such a crude manner at that.
But... there was nothing he could do.
Though this method was simple and violent, its might was extremely domineering, and that was to use brute strength to crush and forcefully take advantage of its opponent.
He San roared in fury, and brandished his sword in attack.
Ling Han raised his fist and threw a punch.
Under the overwhelming power, the sword in He San’s hand instantly slipped out of his grip.
He retreated continuously, while blood continued to drip from his right hand.
That attack just now had caused the web between his thumb and forefinger to split open.
Ling Han strode forwards.
He opened up the major apertures of a complete cycle, forming the very brilliant Starlight Screen.
He San appeared slightly despondent, “How could you possibly be so powerful?
This is impossible!
This is impossible!”

Although he understood that Ling Han’s breakthrough this time was into Mystery Realm Tier, causing his battle prowess to soar, he still couldn’t understand how a Mystery Realm Tier could be as strong as this.
Was this a four-star genius?
No, he was now comparable to a four-star genius of Mystery Realm Tier.
Even if he was slightly inferior, he wouldn’t be too far off.
A four-star genius definitely wouldn’t be able to thrash him so easily.
Five, five-star genius!
He was extremely jealous.
To say nothing of a five-star genius, even four-star geniuses only existed in legends.
He, a three-star genius, could never hope to catch up, yet now he actually discovered that he had actually encountered a five-star genius.
“Nothing is impossible!” Ling Han threw a punch.
He didn’t need to use any secret technique at all, and one punch was enough.
Peng!
He San tried his best to disperse it.
He had used a powerful move, but the result was only just neutralizing it.
His powerful move was actually only capable of dispersing a casual punch from the other?
“Who in the world are you?” He San asked through gritted teeth.
“You’re definitely not from Moonlight Planet..
There’s definitely no such person as you!”

chapters.title: Chapter 3640 - Substitution Seal
paragraphs: Substitution Seal
Translator: Henyee Translations
Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han smiled faintly and said, “When you wanted to kill me, you didn’t care who I was. Now that I’ve turned around to kill you, there’s no need for you to know who I am.”
Humph, if it was not here, I would be able to crush you with one hand!” He San said through gritted teeth.

Hahahaha.” Ling Han laughed loudly, his expression filled with contempt, “I am a descendant of the Great Emperor, and have innumerable rare treasures on me. If we really battle in the outside world, I will take out my Ancestral Weapon, and even if a Saint came, I would be able to kill him.”
F***, wasn’t it just boasting? Who wouldn’t know how to do it?

He San’s whole person trembled. A descendant of a Great Emperor, and he even had an Ancestral Weapon with him. Just how terrifying was that existence? Aside from the Ancestral Kings, Saints were invincible. However, against the Imperial Weapon and Ancestral Weapon, they could only bow their heads in submission.
This young man was actually the descendant of an Ancestral King?
No wonder he was so freakish!
Ling Han spluttered in laughter again. He shook his head, and said, “I was just joking with you. I’m destined to become an emperor, so why would I need to rely on the blessings of an Ancestral King?”
He San couldn’t help but inhale sharply. ‘You really dare to say it.’

Although cultivators who didn’t want to become Ancestral Kings weren’t good cultivators, everyone knew themselves well. Even prodigies such as He San knew that the limit of their lifetime achievements could just possibly be Sect Master-level.
To become a Venerate Tier elite?
Unless he had heaven-defying good fortune and obtained a heaven-defying opportunity. Otherwise, in these many years, why was there only a single Venerate Tier on Moonlight Planet?
Thus, Saints were even rarer. Any Saint would be able to sweep aside all opposition in the universe, and if a Great Emperor did not appear, who would be able to match him?
Yet Ling Han actually confidently declared that he wanted to become an Emperor. Wasn’t this the biggest joke in the world?
No matter how freakish you were, you would only have a one in ten thousand chance of becoming a Saint, what more becoming an Emperor.
“What a joke!” he said coldly.

“Whether it’s a joke or not, you’ll know in the future, but you won’t be able to see this day!” Ling Han charged out again, throwing a punch. It was very ordinary, but seemed capable of destroying the heavens and destroying the earth.
He San parried, but every time he took a blow, he would be throwing up blood endlessly. He was no match for Ling Han at all.
In a battle of equal cultivation levels, Ling Han was invincible!
He San could only draw out the blue energy to match it, but this was too exhausting on him. In a few moments, he was panting heavily.

Ling Han also lost his patience. Originally, He San could have been his whetstone, but now that he had advanced into Mystery Realm Tier, his once powerful opponent could not even withstand a single blow. It was not enough for him to go all out at all.
He would kill him!
He channeled the Destructive Energy, wrapping it around his fists as he faced He San’s blue energy head-on.
This was a clash between two high-level energies. Boom, the fist and the sword clashed, and He San was sent flying. The blue-coloured energy instantly crumbled, and Destructive Energy wreaked havoc.

They were both high-level energies, but there were also qualitative differences. It could only be said that they were of a higher level than mystical power, but there were also rankings among high-level energies.
Boom, under the sweeping attack of Destructive Energy, He San instantly disappeared without a trace.
“So cleanly?” Ling Han was surprised. With He San’s strength, the Destructive Energy should not have blasted him into oblivion with a single strike.
“Hmm?”
Lmg Han looked up at the sky. Two pieces of paper seals fell, and even Destructive Energy didn’t damage them. Instead, it was as if they had only become like this after it had ignited itself.
“Substitution Seal? Ten Thousand Mile Escape Talisman?”
He summoned Tang Yun’er. When the little loll saw these two pieces of broken talisman paper, she immediately called out.
Hearing the name, Ling Han understood. Not only had He San not died, he had even fled.
—The Substitution Seal had saved He San from being killed by the destructive energy, and the Ten Thousand Mile Escape Talisman had instantly sent him tens of thousands of miles away.
Sigh, when there was an elite backing him up, there were a lot of benefits. Previously, he still had a Talisman Weapon to block a fatal attack.
Ling Han felt slightly regretful. This should be a fat sheep. If he could capture him, he would definitely be able to make a fortune.
“Handsome Brother, have you finally defeated that guy?” the little loli asked.
Ling Han nodded with a smile, “Yes.”
Then we can finally leave this godforsaken place, right?” The little loli’s mouth was crooked. What had they eaten these few months? She couldn’t bear it.
“M-hm.”
Ling Han arrived at the agreed upon location. After two days, the seven children and Shen Hanyun came over.
Everyone gathered the essence of Earth together, not only fusing together to form an Earth Element Crystal, but there was also surplus enough for half of another Earth Element Crystal.

Unfortunately, everyone was about to throw up at this place, so they naturally had no interest in fighting anymore - aside from Shen Hanyun. He expressed that he had nothing to do anyways, and wanted to continue killing monsters with the remaining essence of Earth, right until he managed to gather enough to form another Earth Element Crystal.
Ling Han knew that this guy wanted to find something for him to do. Otherwise, if he lost the purpose of his life, he would only be at a loss.
He patted Shen Hanyun’s shoulder, then took his leave.

After leaving the Rolling Stone Wasteland, the little loli summoned the shuttle, and the two of them boarded it. Xiu, it instantly tore through the air and left. ’ This is farewell for now, Moonlight Planet.

Ling Han turned around to look. He thought to himself, ‘It won’t be long before I return here again. At that time, I’ll completely settle accounts with the Pang Clan and the Lei Clan, and if I encounter He San, I won’t mind stepping on him.’ Xiu, the shuttle was extremely fast, and soon entered into the galaxy, beginning to traverse through the nodes of space.
Once, twice, thrice, and after about two months, they finally returned to Celestial Sea Planet.
More than a year had passed since their separation.
“Be careful, don’t crash into anyone again!” Ling Han warned in advance. This little loli was completely a destructive character.
“I know.” The little loli nodded, but looking at her fanatical expression, she was obviously just brushing Ling Han off.

As expected, she steered the shuttle and landed, aiming directly at a sect. Boom, after she crashed into a mountain peak, this mountain peak crumbled forcefully. Countless bits of rubble fell, and dust and sand filled the air, enshrouding an area of several dozen km.
Taking advantage of the chaos, Ling Han hurriedly grabbed the little loli and ran.
Thankfully, this sect was not allied with the Dark North Nation, so he would just treat it as teaching them a lesson.
After spending another three days, Ling Han finally returned to the Imperial Capital.
“Yo, we haven’t seen each other for over a year, and you’ve become even more beautiful,” Ling Han said with a smile after entering the Foreign Affairs Department and seeing Princess Bixiao.
If there was any change in the Foreign Affairs Department, it was that it was much quieter. To say nothing of the fact that it was deserted, it was actually not that much stronger either.
True, now that the forces that should have submitted had also surrendered, the
Foreign Affairs Department was naturally useless.

Princess Bixiao was indeed even more radiant, elegant and lively. It was not that her appearance had changed, but as she had walked further on the Celestial Path, her bearing had naturally become lively and pure.
Upon seeing her, everyone’s first reaction was that she was a celestial maiden descending from the heavens.

Princess Bixiao couldn’t help but be rendered speechless. Now, only Ling Han would dare to speak so glibly to her, but more importantly, this guy did not have the slightest bit of evil thoughts. He was completely teasing her, so she couldn’t get angry even if she wanted to.
“You’ve finally returned. The situation in the Imperial Capital has changed drastically again,” she said..

chapters.title: Chapter 3641 - Imperial Banquet
paragraphs: Imperial Banquet
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han waved his hand dismissively, “Let me catch my breath first. Also, no matter what happens, I have more important things to do first.”
And that naturally was to concoct the Five Elements Karmic Pill. Otherwise, why would he have gone out on a trip in the first place?

Of course, he had reaped huge rewards from this trip. He had obtained a piece of Origin Gold, and this was a good fortune that even Saints did not have. There was also the Buddhist Race’s Six Characters Bright King Curse. Even if it was only a single word, it was still a supreme precious technique.

He first went to concoct the Five Elements Karmic Pill. It was not difficult to concoct, but the difficulty lay in gathering the ingredients. With Ling Han’s abilities as a Grandmaster Alchemist, there was naturally no problem in concocting it.
He constructed a formation, stimulating the flames of heaven and earth, and began to concoct the alchemical pill.
Half a day later, the Five Elements Karmic Pill was completed.
There was only one, and it was a mixture of five colours, yet it formed a perfect balance.
Ling Han didn’t hesitate at all, immediately ingesting the alchemical pill.

At the beginning, the medicinal effects did not take effect. Everything was normal, but very soon, a turbulent change took place. It was clear that his level of being had not advanced, but the shackles were automatically shattering.
It was as if heaven and earth had moved, unleashing his potential.
This process lasted for about an hour, unlocking 10% of the shackles on Ling Han’s body, and this was not what made Ling Han the happiest.
Because with the help of this alchemical pill, Ling Han could completely see the shackles in his body.
Previously, he could only sense the shackles when his level of being was soaring, but it was also seeing one shackle after another, and he had not looked at them from a holistic perspective.

In truth, he did not know how many shackles there were in his body at all. It was like he was running blindfolded, and only knew that he was advancing, but he did not have the slightest impression of how far away the end point was.

But now, he could see how many shackles there were in his body. In future, he would have a direction, and a goal. If these shackles were not broken, he would definitely not break through to Celestial Path.
“I... don’t feel anything.” Ling Han exercised his limbs, but didn’t feel any improvement in his abilities. It was still the same as before.
“Father, unlocking the shackles will only decrease the obstruction of climbing the mountain in the future. It won’t make you immediately become stronger,” Second Baby said.
Ling Han smiled faintly. He was only sighing. In truth, he was already capable of sweeping aside all opposition in Mystery Realm Tier and being invincible within this cultivation level.
Only then did he meet up with Princess Bixiao, and find out about the current situation.

Reality surprised him, because aside from Tang Yun’er and Niu Jianhua, there were actually a great many extraterrestrial visitors that had descended. They were all the descendants of great elites. Their elders had predicted that the Celestial Sea Planet was about to awaken, and there would be great opportunities, so they sent their own descendants over to see if they could gain some glory.

In terms of star level, the grade of the Celestial Sea Planet definitely couldn’t be considered high, but the heaven and eart had just awakened, so there would definitely be a great many thousand-year-old treasured medicines appearing. There were some that even Sect Master-level elites were tempted by, so it was naturally necessary for them to make a trip.

However, the treasure troves had already been allocated cleanly, and there was no news of any Celestial Plants appearing. Hence, a great many extraterrestrial outsiders settled down in the Imperial Capital. After all, this place was prosperous.

“Now, from the Eldest Imperial Prince to the Thirteenth Imperial Prince, all of them have leaped over the Celestial Gate and become Foundation Building Tier elites,” Princess Bixiao said. “You must be careful. Though His Majesty is protecting you, those people are His Majesty’s own children, after all. Even if they really killed you, His Majesty would not punish them harshly.”

In a one-on-one battle, she was unafraid of even the Eldest Imperial Prince, who was born with a Divine Physique. However, if it was a battle of one against thirteen, even if she could match them, it was inevitable that she would be careless. It was impossible that she would be able to protect Ling Han completely.
Ling Han nodded. Right now, the pressure on him was still quite heavy. After all, if he wasn’t a Foundation Building cultivator, he would only be a mortal in the end.
“As long as all the shackles are unlocked, I will begin to break through to Celestial Path.”
Ling Han thought. He was sure that by that time, he would have accumulated enough mystical power to leap over the Celestial Gate.

Next, he began to live a low-key life. He stayed in his room all day and cultivated for a while. Most of his time was spent on the practice of the An character. This Buddhist Race technique was truly extensive and profound. It was clearly just a single word, yet it could produce all kinds of changes.
He discovered that he was still far from grasping the true meaning of this word.

After the little loli and the pervert pig met, they actually hit it off at first sight, and began to plan something in collusion. Ling Han couldn’t be bothered to care about them either. He only said that it was fine if they wanted to cause damage, but they definitely had to target bad people.
For example, the Seventh Imperial Prince.
A few days later, Princess Bixiao came to look for him.
“Empress Ma, Imperial Consort Lin and the others have joined forces to host a banquet, and have also given two invitations to the Foreign Affairs Department,” this princess of the Demon Race said.

chapters.title: Chapter 3642 - Forced Marriage
paragraphs: Forced Marriage
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations
Although martial arts had recovered, and modern technology could no longer contend with martial artists, there were still some things that were very practical.
For example, a car.

Ling Han and Princess Bixiao sat in an extended car, which was very eye-catching. However, the speed was really too slow, and it took them more than 40 minutes to finally arrive within the vicinity of the Imperial Palace. Originally, this place was a restricted area, and the driver could not go any further, but this time, Ling Han and the princess both had invitations, so he told the driver to continue driving.
At the entrance to the Imperial Palace, they were stopped, and only after carefully examining their invitations, were they allowed to pass.

The driver was extremely excited. It was naturally impossible for him to enter into the Imperial Palace, but now, not only had he entered, he had even driven his car in, making him feel as if he was in a dream.
Very quickly, the car arrived at Jiuhua Palace.

The driver refused to accept the money no matter what, and said, “Milord and lady, it’s all thanks to you that I had the chance to enter the Imperial Palace and realize my lifelong dream. How can I still accept your money?”
With these words, Ling Han and Princess Bixiao didn’t insist any longer. They alighted from the car.
It wasn’t time for the banquet yet, but there was already a sea of people here.

Obviously, the empress and the Imperial Consorts had invited a great many people this time. The Foreign Affairs Department only had two invitations, and that was because the Imperial Princes and the Foreign Affairs Department did not have a good relationship with the Foreign Affairs Department, so they had only given two invitations to be polite.

By the looks of it, all the clans in the Imperial Capital, large and small, had been invited. However, a great many people were not qualified to enter into the palace, so they could only join in on the excitement outside.
But for these people, being able to enter into the Imperial Palace was already a great honour.

Not only were there clans from the Imperial Capital, but there were also sects and forces that had submitted to the Dark North Nation. The empress had sent an invitation, so who would dare to take it lightly?
This was the wife of a Spirit Transformation True Lord. No matter what, they had to give her some face.
Thus, today was really a day when everyone revolved around the main characters.

Ling Han and Princess Bixiao were extremely low-key, and they didn’t greet anyone. However, Princess Bixiao was far too beautiful, and she immediately became the focus of everyone’s attention upon disembarking from the car. They all stared at her without blinking.

Even now, there was still an extremely limited number of newly advanced Celestial Path elites, and as for females, only Princess Bixiao was one of them. Even if she was not very beautiful, she would still gain a great deal of attention, what more when she was breathtakingly beautiful.

The two of them couldn’t keep a low profile even if they wanted to. The crowds discussed spiritedly, and the news of the arrival of the two Chiefs of the Foreign Affairs Department quickly spread out.
Ling Han didn’t mind. So be it if it was known. If he was afraid of trouble, he wouldn’t have come either.

After entering the hall, the two of them found their own seats. However, what was infuriating was that not only were their seats not together, but Ling Han, the Chief of the Department, actually fell far behind Princess Bixiao.
Was this in accordance with the rules?
Ling Han stroked his chin and said, “His Majesty personally bestowed you the title of Princess. Thus, it’s reasonable to place you in front.”
Princess Bixiao frowned and said, “This is clearly a show of strength for you. They want to embarrass you, and you’re just going to tolerate it?”
This was not in line with Ling Han’s personality.
Ling Han smiled and said, “Look at what you’re saying. Am I the kind of person who would take revenge for the smallest grievance?”
Princess Bixiao did not speak, but her eyes were filled with certainty.

“It’s fine. Believe me, I’ve been cultivating my temperament recently. As long as others don’t step on top of me, I can’t be bothered,” Ling Han said with a smile. Though Princess Bixiao did not quite believe it, she did not say anything. She went ahead.

She was exquisitely beautiful, and now that she had advanced into Celestial Path, her bearing was also ethereal and captivating. Naturally, she was immediately revered by the masses. All the Imperial Princes gathered around her, trying their best to curry her favour.
To say nothing else, merely the fact that she was the first person to advance into Celestial Path after the awakening of heaven and earth made her worthy of marrying.

It was not just the Imperial Princes. The extraterrestrial visitors were also very interested in Princess Bixiao. They were completely unafraid of those Imperial Princes, and similarly approached to cotton up to her.
When it was seven o’clock, the sky was already completely dark, and the guests had all arrived. Empress Ma and the other Imperial Consorts all came out, and a dead silence instantly fell.

Though their strength was very ordinary, they were the wives and concubines of a Spirit Transformation True Lord, so they naturally had to be respected. After a few words from the noblewomen, the banquet began.

Ling Han merely ate with his head lowered. He couldn’t be bothered to lower himself to the level of these women. Speaking of which, they were all his juniors, so he couldn’t bring himself to argue with them.
Of course, the prerequisite was that they did not trifle with him.

With Chen Fengyan suppressing them, the atmosphere was extremely harmonious. Everyone was complimenting the Eldest Imperial Prince and the others, praising them as giants among men, and saying that their future achievements wouldn’t be inferior to Chen Fengyan’s.

Ling Han almost wanted to sleep upon hearing this. As he saw it, aside from the Eldest Imperial Prince, who still had some future prospects, the other Imperial Princes were all mediocre. At most, they would only advance into the Cauldron Forging Tier.
“Bixiao!” Empress Ma suddenly changed the topic to Princess Bixiao, “It has already been two years since you came to the Imperial Capital, right?”
“That’s right,” Princess Bixiao said gently, though she could smack that noble lady who was seated high up in the main seat to death with a single wave of her hand.
Empress Ma nodded, and continued, “Then after so much time has passed, you had best think carefully. Which Imperial Prince are you going to marry?” Yi, was this a forced marriage?

When the Demon Race princess entered into the Imperial Capital, she had come with the mission of marriage. She was going to marry a certain Imperial Prince, but it was up to her to decide who she would marry.
Now, Empress Ma was forcing her in public, forcing Princess Bixiao to make a choice.
Everyone was paying attention, and the Eldest Imperial Prince and the others all looked proud. A few of them were even looking at Ling Han with provoking eyes.
—What right do you think you have to sit here?
It was to let you see this scene with your own eyes.
No matter what choice Princess Bixiao made, it would still be benefiting them. She would marry an Imperial Prince, and would have no chance with Ling Han.
Ling Han remained calm and collected. He wanted to see how Princess Bixiao would choose. Worse come to worst, he would reveal his identity as Chen Fengyan’s uncle, and slap them one after another.

Princess Bixiao smiled faintly, and said, “Bixiao is presently prioritizing cultivating. Furthermore, after Your Imperial Highnesses have advanced into Celestial Path, your lifespans would be at least in the thousands, so there is absolutely no need for you to be anxious.”

“How could that be allowed!” Empress Ma shook her head, “As the saying goes, one should get married and start their career, and only after they have married, would they be able to rest easy. Bixiao, could it be that you think that there is not a single Imperial Prince that is worthy of you?”
These words were very harsh.

“Empress Ma, you’ve gone too far with your words!” A young man suddenly stood up, “I think Lady Bixiao’s words are reasonable. As cultivators, we should set aside our romantic affairs and pursue that supreme great dao.”

His name was Zhu Sen, and he was an extraterrestrial visitor. He himself was an elite of the Foundation Building Tier, and his grandfather was also a Spirit Transformation True Lord. Thus, there was no need for him to revere Empress Ma.

“That’s right.” Another young man stood up, holding a wine cup in his hand, appearing extremely casual, “Furthermore, the matter of marriage still has to depend on the wishes of both parties. What meaning is there to force them to be together?”
His name was Zhou Yang, and he was also an extraterrestrial visitor. His background wasn’t inferior to Zhu Sen’s..

chapters.title: Chapter 3643 - All the Imperial Princes were defeated
paragraphs: All the Imperial Princes were defeated
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations
Empress Ma’s expression was slightly ugly.

She was using this banquet to force a marriage from Princess Bixiao, and was definitely going to force her to express her stand. She had not thought that two extraterrestrial visitors would actually interfere.
What did this have to do with them?

She knew that Zhu Sen and Zhou Yang had definitely taken a fancy to Princess Bixiao, and that was why they were “speaking up for justice”. However, there was nothing she could do. Their background was not the slightest bit inferior to hers, so what could she use to suppress them?

Moreover, the Celestial Sea Planet’s situation was very delicate at this moment. Although Chen Fengyan could withstand the pressure of the other four Spirit Transformation True Lords, what about a few more?
Thus, Empress Ma didn’t dare to be stubborn and help Chen Fengyan make another powerful enemy.
Her words were stifled, and she could not speak at all.
When Imperial Consort Liu saw this, she hurriedly continued, “Alright, well talk about Bixiao later. Today is the Imperial Princes’ big day. Come, let’s drink.”
“Congratulations, Imperial Princes, for leaping over the Celestial Gate and becoming Foundation Building elites!”
“Having stepped onto the Celestial Path, one can pursue the great dao!”
“This is the fortune of our Empire.”
Everyone was boot-licking. However, those extraterrestrial visitors all looked disdainful.
They were really a group of ignorant boors. Was it worth being so excited about having stepped onto the Celestial Path?

On their planet, wouldn’t it be a matter of course to become a Foundation Building cultivator? With the background of Spirit Transformation Tier-level, it would be strange if they couldn’t step onto the Celestial Path.

It could not be helped. This planet had just awakened, so it was very normal for cultivation to be wilted. If it was not for the fact that the prison had been opened ahead of time, extraterrestrial visitors like them would be able to sweep aside all opposition and be invincible.

The Eldest Imperial Prince and the others were all glowing with happiness. Today was the day that they would reach the pinnacle of their lives. This was the Celestial Path, a height that they could only look up to in the past.

Now that they had set foot, they would be able to reach the apex in the future. With a father who was a Spirit Transformation True Lord, sheltering them from the elements and snatching opportunities for them, their future prospects would be limitless.

“I’m Zhou Yang, and I’ve just formed my Heavenly Dao Foundation. However, I’m willing to seal my cultivation level to Human Dao Foundation. I’d like to ask for some guidance from the Imperial Princes,” a disharmonious voice suddenly said.
The extraterrestrial visitor, Zhou Yang, stood up once more, provoking the Eldest Imperial Prince and the others.
Should they accept it or not?

They definitely had to accept the challenge. The other party had already called them out, and he had also said that he would seal his cultivation level. If they still didn’t dare to accept the challenge, what face would the Imperial Family have?

The expressions of Empress Ma, Imperial Consort Liu and the others were all dark. These outsiders were really not giving them any face. Previously, they had spoken up for Princess Bixiao, and now, they were issuing a challenge to the Imperial Princes. To publicly embarrass them like this was really going too far.
However, he had a very powerful background, and it was not appropriate for the Dark North Nation to make any more powerful enemies, so they really could not afford to offend him.
To say the least, even if they wanted to suppress him, there was nothing they could do.
Zhou Yang was a Heavenly Dao Foundation elite, but how many elites were there in the Imperial Family?
Could it be that he still had to ask the sects that had submitted to them to make a move?
That would really be hilarious. The Imperial Family was really too weak.
Thus, after the Imperial Princes exchanged looks, the Thirteenth Imperial Prince was the first to step out, and say, “Then please provide guidance.”
Zhou Yang showed a hint of mockery, “Please.”
The two of them exchanged blows, and in only ten moves, the Thirteenth Prince was suppressed.

“Young Master Zhou, what meaning is there to suppress others with your cultivation level?” a courtier said. He had received instructions from Empress Ma. Otherwise, how could a mere Inscription Tier cultivator like him dare to challenge a Foundation Building elite?
Zhou Yang did not speak, and merely sent out a palm strike towards the Tenth Imperial Prince.
Boom, a frightening power surged out, and the Tenth Imperial Prince was completely unable to match it, and was instantly sent flying.
This was his answer.
You see, if I displayed the strength of Heavenly Dao Foundation, I would be as strong as this.
Furthermore, he had made an example of the Tenth Imperial Prince to display his true battle prowess. Just how much contempt was he showing?
So what if they were from the Imperial Family? He was completely unafraid. ‘You guys aren’t Chen Fengyan!’
Everyone was rendered speechless. Indeed, Zhou Yang hadn’t won the battle against the Thirteenth Prince with his cultivation level. Instead, it was because his battle prowess was far too powerful.
“Allow me to spar with you,” the Ninth Prince said as he walked over. His body was astonishingly sturdy, and it was as if he were a vicious bear.
“Make your move,” Zhou Yang said calmly.
The Ninth Prince moved, yet he was defeated after only 10 exchanges.
That made it two consecutive losses.
The Seventh Imperial Prince also stepped out, and said, “Brother Zhou’s strength is truly extraordinary. Let me spar with you.”

He was skilled in Spiritual Power, and after advancing into Celestial Path, this had been fully developed, making him confident that even against the Eldest Imperial Prince, who was born with a Divine Physique, he would not lose.
The Seventh Imperial Prince moved. With a thought, xiu, xiu, xiu, innumerable short swords instantly shot out from his body, and shot towards Zhou Yang like a barrage of arrows.
“Yi, what a powerful Spiritual Power!” Zhou Yang showed a hint of seriousness. The attacks of Spiritual Power elites were surprising, and could be delivered from any angle, catching others off guard.
However, he was fearless. How strong could the battle prowess of a person from a place that was lagging behind in martial arts be?

The Seventh Imperial Prince was not too bad. At one point, he had managed to exchange a few blows with Zhou Yang, but just when everyone was cheering for him, thinking that he could win back some face for the Dark North Nation, Zhou Yang suddenly exploded, and defeated the Seventh Imperial Prince in a few moves.
Ling Han could see very clearly that the Seventh Imperial Prince had actually lost because he did not have a good Spiritual Power Spirit Tool.

If the Seventh Imperial Prince possessed the Heavenly Pattern Jade, it was guaranteed that Zhou Yang would be a hundred times more troubled, and it would be difficult to say who would emerge victorious.
But once the Seventh Imperial Prince was defeated, aside from the Eldest Imperial Prince, the other Imperial Princes all gave up any thoughts of making a move.
They had competed internally before, and the Seventh Imperial Prince’s battle prowess was only inferior to the Eldest Imperial Prince.
All of a sudden, everyone’s eyes were focused on the Eldest Imperial Prince.
The Eldest Imperial Prince had no choice but to move. The pride of the Imperial Family and the pride of the Dark North Nation were all on his shoulders. He had to defend this stage.
However, he wasn’t confident at all. His opponent was truly powerful, so much so that even with his innate Divine Physique, he had absolutely no chance of winning.

The two of them battled, and it wasn’t long before the Eldest Imperial Prince unleashed his full power. He even activated his natural Mystical Power, causing countless shards of green light to descend from the sky. Their might was tremendous.
“Yi, this is Mystical Power?” Zhou Yang knew what was good for him, and he said in surprise, “I never thought that you would actually have an Innate Divine Physique!”
Innate Divine Physiques were too rare. At least, he wasn’t one of them.
Even if the Eldest Imperial Prince was only a ninth grade Innate Divine Physique, he was still incredibly powerful. Once the Mystical Power was used, he instantly gained the upper hand.
Everyone cheered loudly, finally regaining their momentum.

However, the extraterrestrial visitors were all extremely calm. An Innate Divine Physique was indeed powerful, but after advancing into Celestial Path, those who used Divine Stones to build their foundations were not the slightest bit weak. Some top grade Divine Stones were even comparable to the second grade Divine Physiques.
As expected, Zhou Yang very quickly began his counterattack, and used a celestial technique. It was extraordinarily powerful, and managed to block the Eldest Imperial Prince’s Mystical Power.
The Mystical Power was indeed powerful, but it could not be channelled endlessly. This had a strong burden on the body, and could only be used as a powerful move.
Thus, once the Eldest Imperial Prince’s burst of power had passed, he immediately fell into a predicament of being on the back foot. Very soon, he was defeated.
At this point, the army of Imperial Princes was completely annihilated.
A proud expression appeared on Zhou Yang’s face, and he said, “Is there any other Imperial Prince that wants to spar with me?”
Everyone was silent. Their skills were inferior, so it would only be more humiliating if they tried to put on airs.
“Hahaha!” Those extraterrestrial visitors laughed loudly, filled with disdain.
This primitive land could not even withstand a single blow.
The faces of the ministers of the Dark North Nation were all burning hot. They were being slapped in the face like this in their own court; they couldn’t bear it!
But there was nothing that could be done. Who asked that the battle prowess of the Imperial Princes were indeed inferior?

Was there anyone, ah, was there anyone that could step out and deliver a harsh beating on these guys? How could it be that they could not find a single true prodigy in such a colossal planet and such a large country?
It was a shame that Hong Tianbu had betrayed them. Otherwise, he would definitely have been able to turn the tide.
“A battle at the same cultivation level?” Amidst this silence, a lazy voice rang out, “Let me teach you a lesson!”

chapters.title: Chapter 3644 - Nine Battles, Nine Victories
paragraphs: Nine Battles, Nine Victories
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations
Someone still jumped out at this time?
Everyone turned to look at the source of the voice, and their hearts all jolted.
So it was this guy.
...The two prodigies of the Imperial Capital, aside from Hong Tianbu, there was also Ling Han!
Faced with multiple pairs of eyes, Ling Han was still slowly eating, as if those bold words just now had not come from his mouth.
Zhou Yang sneered, and said, “A mere Mystery Realm Tier is worthy of fighting me?”

Ling Han was unmoved, and said calmly, “Come, suppress your cultivation level to the Mystery Realm Tier. I will defeat you within ten moves, and if I need one more move, I will make an exception and take you as my godson.” F* * *, how could this guy be so mean?
Zhou Yang couldn’t help but fly into a rage, “Ant, are you seeking death?”
“Do you dare? Just say the word,” Ling Han provoked.
“I don’t dare?” Zhou Yang shook his head, and said, “I’m just disdainful.”
Ling Han pondered for a moment before retrieving the Heavenly Pattern Jade and shaking it. “I’ll use it as a wager. Whoever can defeat me at the same cultivation level can take this item away.”
“A Spiritual Power Spirit Tool!”
“Heavenly Pattern Jade!”
Zhou Yang, Zhu Sen, and the others all exclaimed in shock, looking envious.

They naturally knew what was what. Spiritual Power Spirit Tools were extremely rare, so even though it was only Two Star material, they were still tempted. In fact, even elites of the Core Formation Tier would treat them as treasures.
“I’ll go!”
“I’ll fight you!”
“No, I’ll go!”
Zhou Yang and the others were all in a rush to call out. They all wanted to exchange blows with Ling Han. How could a prodigy exist in a backward place like Celestial Sea Planet?
Thus, whoever made the first move would be able to obtain the Heavenly Pattern Jade.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and said, “It’s easy to challenge me. Show me a treasure of equal value.”
Hold on, when did it become challenging you?
Didn’t you f jump out on your own volition?
However, the Heavenly Pattern Jade was too valuable, so they had no time to bother about this.

“I have a three-hundred-year-old yellow ginseng here. It is very nutritious to the blood and Qi, and can save one’s life at crucial moments,” Zhou Yang was the first to say. He took out a ginseng, and placed it on the table.
“All right, let’s battle.” Ling Han nodded.
Zhou Yang walked over, suppressing his cultivation level as he did so. The Celestial Path aura immediately disappeared.
Now, he was only Mystery Realm Tier-level.
Ling Han clasped his hands behind his back and said, “Those who want to challenge me, line up. You must bring out something good. If there is nothing good, I will not accept a challenge.”
F***, you are really too conceited, aren’t you? We haven’t even fought, and you think that you have defeated Zhou Yang?
As the person involved, Zhou Yang was naturally the most furious. In this primitive place, someone actually dared to look down on him like this?
He humphed, “How preposterous!”
Zhou Yang leaped forwards with a single step, and he immediately charged toward Ling Han. He was already impatient, and he wanted to defeat Ling Han to avoid being annoyed.
Facts talked louder than words.
“I’ll let you have the first ten moves.” Ling Han parried casually, only defending and not attacking.

Zhou Yang didn’t know Ling Han’s strength, so he simply thought that Ling Han couldn’t fight back at all. However, Ling Han was still stubbornly refusing to admit defeat. He humphed, and his attacks became even more rapid.

After only a few moves, Ling Han was sure that Zhou Yang should be a one-star genius. However, now that he had suppressed his cultivation level to the Mystery Realm Tier, Zhou Yang’s battle prowess was close to two stars, which was very extraordinary.

It was no wonder that he could defeat all the Imperial Princes. Even the Eldest Imperial Prince, who was born with a Divine Physique, was no match for him. A one-star genius was indeed very strong, and added with the fact that he had grasped a profound celestial technique, even the Eldest Imperial Prince was no match for him.
Seeing that Ling Han was only defending and not attacking, everyone also felt that it was normal.
He was an extraterrestrial visitor. Didn’t he see that even the Eldest Imperial Prince and the others had been defeated? Then what was so strange about Ling Han being outmatched?
However, you were so high-profile just now, and now you have been slapped in the face. Doesn’t that hurt?
This was also a humiliation to the Dark North Nation.
If Ling Han unleashed his might, he would be able to insta-kill Zhou Yang with a single move. However, if he did that, who would dare make a bet with him?
Wouldn’t that mean that there was no profit to be earned?
Thus, Ling Han’s action was naturally a long-term plan to catch a big fish.
—If the seven babies were here, with their understanding of Ling Han, they would definitely have long since known that Ling Han had begun to play tricks.
After several hundred exchanges, Ling Han finally started to unleash his might, defeating Zhou Yang with a slight advantage.

“Thanks.” Ling Han walked over and picked up the three-hundred-year-old yellow ginseng. He then wore an arrogant expression as he said, “Is there anyone else? Is there anyone else who can fight? What extraterrestrial visitor? He can’t even withstand a single blow.”

Hearing these words, Zhu Sen and the others were all enraged. This brat was really too arrogant, wasn’t he? He had only narrowly defeated Zhou Yang with a single move, and that was completely luck. What was there to be proud of?

“Everyone, step aside. I’ll deal with this brat.” A man in black walked out. He took out a piece of green metal and placed it on the table, “This is one star material, Tragic Green Metal. Is it enough?”

One Star ingredients naturally couldn’t compare to Two Star ingredients. Moreover, the Heavenly Pattern Jade was a Spiritual Power Spirit Tool at that, which was far more valuable than ordinary Two Star ingredients.
Ling Han didn’t mind. In any case, it was just earning some extra income.
“Not enough, but it doesn’t matter. In any case, you will definitely lose,” Ling Han said challengingly.
“You are really quite arrogant.” The man in black rushed over, and launched a fierce offensive.

Ling Han was still the same as before. He didn’t win with a single strike. Instead, he continued to battle with his opponent, giving the others the illusion that their strength was more or less equal.
After several hundred exchanges like this, Ling Han finally strengthened his offensive, defeating the man in black.
Two consecutive wins!
This time, everyone had a whole new respect for Ling Han.
In terms of the first battle, Ling Han had only been lucky. The two consecutive wins were enough to prove that was not the case.
This was not a stroke of luck.
Ling Han put away the Tragic Green Metal as well, “Sigh, can’t you send out a decent opponent? Sigh, they’re not even enough for me to fight.”
This was too arrogant, too arrogant.

“You’re nothing but a pawn from a backward place. Where do you get such arrogance from?” Another extraterrestrial visitor stepped out. He put down an alchemical pill, “This is the Three Transformations Pill, a Pseudo One Star alchemical pill. It can stimulate the evolution of level of being, and is greatly beneficial to you.”

Ling Han couldn’t help but feel disappointed. Although the effects of the Three Transformations Pill were what he needed, he had already ingested the Five Elements Karmic Pill. There was actually no meaning to ingesting an alchemical pill with a similar effect.
Otherwise, wouldn’t it be better to concoct two Five Elements Karmic Pills?
Forget it. If he didn’t use it himself, he could give it to others.
“Barely.” Ling Han waved his hand.
‘F*ck! You’re starting to look down on me?’
“Come battle.”
The battle began, and Ling Han still followed the old rules. He dragged out the battle for 300 moves before finally defeating his opponent.
Three consecutive wins.
Ling Han became more and more arrogant. To him, attracting animosity was really too easy. He only needed to act as he was.
One after another, extraterrestrial visitors leaped out. They could not bear this provocation; it was too infuriating.
One person came, and one person lost. There was no one that could defeat Ling Han.
Nine battles, nine victories.
This time, those extraterrestrial visitors were all dumbfounded. Nine battles, nine victories. Though they had all barely won, it was enough to illustrate the problem.
Ling Han was very, very strong, though he was very arrogant, causing others to grit their teeth in hatred.

“Anyone else?” Ling Han said with a smile. He swept his gaze around, but no one answered. Now, everyone had to consider whether they were stronger than the previous nine people. Otherwise, if they went up, they would only be delivering a defeat, and be humiliated in vain.
“I’ll go.” After a long time, Zhu Sen walked out..

However, if he did that, who would dare make a bet with him?
Wouldn’t that mean that there was no profit to be earned?
Thus, Ling Han’s action was naturally a long-term plan to catch a big fish.
—If the seven babies were here, with their understanding of Ling Han, they would definitely have long since known that Ling Han had begun to play tricks.
After several hundred exchanges, Ling Han finally started to unleash his might, defeating Zhou Yang with a slight advantage.
“Thanks.” Ling Han walked over and picked up the three-hundred-year-old yellow ginseng.
He then wore an arrogant expression as he said, “Is there anyone else?
Is there anyone else who can fight?
What extraterrestrial visitor?
He can’t even withstand a single blow.”
Hearing these words, Zhu Sen and the others were all enraged.
This brat was really too arrogant, wasn’t he?
He had only narrowly defeated Zhou Yang with a single move, and that was completely luck.
What was there to be proud of?
“Everyone, step aside.
I’ll deal with this brat.” A man in black walked out.
He took out a piece of green metal and placed it on the table, “This is one star material, Tragic Green Metal.
Is it enough?”
One Star ingredients naturally couldn’t compare to Two Star ingredients.
Moreover, the Heavenly Pattern Jade was a Spiritual Power Spirit Tool at that, which was far more valuable than ordinary Two Star ingredients.
Ling Han didn’t mind.
In any case, it was just earning some extra income.
“Not enough, but it doesn’t matter.
In any case, you will definitely lose,” Ling Han said challengingly.
“You are really quite arrogant.” The man in black rushed over, and launched a fierce offensive.
Ling Han was still the same as before.
He didn’t win with a single strike.
Instead, he continued to battle with his opponent, giving the others the illusion that their strength was more or less equal.
After several hundred exchanges like this, Ling Han finally strengthened his offensive, defeating the man in black.
Two consecutive wins!
This time, everyone had a whole new respect for Ling Han.
In terms of the first battle, Ling Han had only been lucky.
The two consecutive wins were enough to prove that was not the case.
This was not a stroke of luck.
Ling Han put away the Tragic Green Metal as well, “Sigh, can’t you send out a decent opponent?
Sigh, they’re not even enough for me to fight.”
This was too arrogant, too arrogant.
“You’re nothing but a pawn from a backward place.
Where do you get such arrogance from?” Another extraterrestrial visitor stepped out.
He put down an alchemical pill, “This is the Three Transformations Pill, a Pseudo One Star alchemical pill.
It can stimulate the evolution of level of being, and is greatly beneficial to you.”
Ling Han couldn’t help but feel disappointed.
Although the effects of the Three Transformations Pill were what he needed, he had already ingested the Five Elements Karmic Pill.
There was actually no meaning to ingesting an alchemical pill with a similar effect.
Otherwise, wouldn’t it be better to concoct two Five Elements Karmic Pills?
Forget it.
If he didn’t use it himself, he could give it to others.
“Barely.” Ling Han waved his hand.
‘F*ck!
You’re starting to look down on me?’
“Come battle.”
The battle began, and Ling Han still followed the old rules.
He dragged out the battle for 300 moves before finally defeating his opponent.
Three consecutive wins.
Ling Han became more and more arrogant.
To him, attracting animosity was really too easy.
He only needed to act as he was.
One after another, extraterrestrial visitors leaped out.
They could not bear this provocation; it was too infuriating.
One person came, and one person lost.
There was no one that could defeat Ling Han.
Nine battles, nine victories.
This time, those extraterrestrial visitors were all dumbfounded.
Nine battles, nine victories.
Though they had all barely won, it was enough to illustrate the problem.
Ling Han was very, very strong, though he was very arrogant, causing others to grit their teeth in hatred.
“Anyone else?” Ling Han said with a smile.
He swept his gaze around, but no one answered.
Now, everyone had to consider whether they were stronger than the previous nine people.
Otherwise, if they went up, they would only be delivering a defeat, and be humiliated in vain.
“I’ll go.” After a long time, Zhu Sen walked out..

chapters.title: Chapter 3645 - Just a single punch
paragraphs: Just a single punch
Translator: Henyee Translations I Editor: Henyee Translations
This should be the last one.

Ling Han sighed internally. No one was an idiot, especially those extraterrestrial visitors that had been sent here. All of them were descendants of their clans, the prized sons of their sects, and all of them were extremely intelligent.
He had fought nine battles and claimed nine victories. Though these were all very “difficult” victories, they would still be seen through.
-Pretending to be a pig to eat a tiger, and deliberately setting a trap.
“There’s only one?” Ling Han deliberately looked around, “I don’t mind if you guys have a few more, five then. How about all of you attack together?” No one answered.
“Ten?” Ling Han relaxed the conditions again. “I’ll fight ten by myself. If I lose, you guys leave the treasures behind. If you win, you can take the Heavenly Pattern Jade.”
Instantly, a few people were itching to give it a try, but in the end, no one responded.
Sigh, what a bunch of cowards. They were scared just like that.
“Even with ten of you, you wouldn’t dare; I really overestimated you guys!” Ling Han shook his head, his expression filled with mockery.
Seeing how arrogant he was, while the extraterrestrial visitors almost exploded in anger, the people from the Dark North Nation were all indescribably excited. This was what it meant to be f prOud!
Sure enough, the title of the Twin Prodigies of the Imperial Capital wasn’t for nothing.
It was fine even if Hong Tianbu left. They still had Ling Han, who could sweep aside all opponents at the same cultivation level.

However, the expressions of Empress Ma, the other consorts, the Eldest Imperial Prince and the others were all extremely unfriendly. The enmity between them and Ling Han had become very serious, so they naturally could not bear to see Ling Han act so mighty.

It was fine whoever could redeem the pride of the Dark North Nation for Ling Han, but it definitely couldn’t be Ling Han. Instead of having him redeem the pride of the Dark North Nation, it would be better to lose face.

“Brat, you still haven’t defeated me yet!” Zhu Sen said calmly. He was filled with confidence in himself. If Ling Han’s abilities were the same as what he had previously displayed, his chances of victory were assured.

Ling Han crooked a finger. Zhu Sen took out a One Star Celestial medicine. He was quite satisfied with that. After advancing into Celestial Path, he would begin concocting Celestial pills, and naturally needed Celestial medicines as the main ingredient.
“Brat, you are too arrogant!”
“He’s just lucky and won by a narrow margin. What’s there to be proud of?”
“If Brother Zhu makes a move, you will definitely lose.”

The extraterrestrial visitors all called out. Originally, there had not been any relations between them, but now, they were united against a common enemy. Zhu Sen was brimming with confidence as he strode toward Ling Han. Boom! Fiery flames erupted from his body, and it was as if they were heaven-reaching flames.
Yi?

Ling Han was stunned for a moment. If he used Spiritual Power to communicate with high-level energy, it would only be able to entwine the high-level energy around his hands and feet. At most, he would still have the opened apertures, so mystical power would be released from the apertures, and his whole person would be like a porcupine.
The current Zhu Sen was completely different. His whole person was wrapped in flames, yet did not hurt him in the slightest.
Realization dawned on him. Zhu Sen was an Innate Divine Physique.
“Mystical Power of Flames,” Ling Han said with a smile.
Zhu Sen said proudly, “I am an eighth grade Divine Physique!”

Even though it was only eighth grade, the Innate Divine Physique was extremely rare. Even if only a ninth grade Divine Physique appeared, it would still alert the heaven and earth. Thunder would rumble, and an eighth grade Innate Divine Physique would definitely be even more powerful.
No wonder he dared to step out and issue a challenge even though he clearly knew that Ling Han was a wolf in sheep’s clothing.
The Innate Divine Physique was stronger when encountering others.
Ling Han cracked a smile, and said, “So what if you have an Innate Divine Physique? I can defeat you with a single punch!”
Arrogant!” Zhu Sen said with a cold chuckle. He leaped over like a god of flames.
Ling Han was finally getting serious. Boom! The apertures of a complete cycle lit up at the same time, forming a screen of light around him. Then, he threw a punch at Zhu Sen.
With his current strength, he had already used a Mystical Power, so what need was there for him to use other techniques?

The flames surged over, yet they were completely unable to penetrate the starlight Screen. However, Ling Han’s fist was unstoppable, and a terrifying power surged. Peng! It was like a great mountain was crushing down, penetrating Zhu Sen’s defenses and striking his chest.
Then, Zhu Sen was sent flying.
“Ah!” Zhu Sen roared in fury. His body was in midair, but a terrifying aura was surging within his body. That was the Celestial Path-level oppressive might that could crush mortals.
He released the suppression of his cultivation level, and became an elite of Heavenly Dao Foundation again.
This was too despicable. A native from a backward place had actually sent him flying with a single punch.
Humiliating, this was too humiliating!
There was complete silence.

Though everyone had already guessed that Ling Han had been screwing others over all this while, deliberately making it seem as if he was locked in a stalemate with his opponent, and his motive was to trick them into making a bet with him, they had never imagined that once he went all out, Ling Han would be as strong as this.
An eighth grade Innate Divine Physique! Moreover, he had used the Mystical
Power, yet he had actually been sent flying with a single punch!
-If Zhu Sen had not released his Foundation Building cultivation level in time,
this punch would have been enough to half-kill him.
He was too strong.
How could there be such a powerful Mystery Realm Tier?
If Ling Han advanced into Celestial Path, just how powerful would he be?

That’s right. There were indeed a great many prodigies that had disappeared among the masses after leaping over the Celestial Gate, but there were a great many prodigies that had maintained their standards, and continued to be freakish. And with Ling Han’s present standards, even if he had been slightly weaker when leaping over the Celestial Gate, half of a hundred feet tall tree was still much taller than a ten feet tall tree.
This kind of freak... just the thought of it was terrifying.
He should just kill him to get rid of future trouble.
All of a sudden, practically all the extraterrestrial visitors were filled with killing intent, as they all stared at Ling Han.

Princess Bixiao was extremely anxious. Though her battle prowess was extraordinary, she would only be able to block one or two cultivators of the same cultivation level, at most. After advancing into Celestial Path, the gap among prodigies had actually shrunk. Furthermore, among these extraterrestrial visitors, which one of them was mediocre?

Meanwhile, the Imperial Princes all smiled slightly. It was not appropriate for them to make a move on Ling Han, but there was no rule that stated that if others made a move on Ling Han, they would still have to step out and resolve the matter.
Die, this kind of prodigy that would steal their limelight.
They didn’t care. In any case, their old man was a Spirit Transformation True Lord, so how could it be that the Dark North Nation needed a Mystery Realm Tier to support it?
Ling Han stood proudly, a faint smile on his face, appearing extremely calm.
He wasn’t confident in his own strength, but he was confident that Chen Fengyan definitely wouldn’t allow outsiders to behave atrociously in the Imperial Capital. Moreover, he was his uncle!

As expected, the great formation of the Imperial Capital was activated. A light figure took human form, and said calmly, “Cultivators of Celestial Path are not allowed to make a move on mortals. Anyone who disobeys will be killed!” His voice wasn’t loud, yet it was filled with a domineering aura. Even heaven and earth had to obey his commands!
Zhu Sen was just about to attack, yet he forcefully suppressed his urge.
This shadowy figure was far too powerful, so much so that even he felt apprehensive.
Formation Spirit?
No, it wasn’t that simple. It shpould be a combination of a Formation Spirit and the will of a Spirit Transformation True Lord.
“Greetings, True Lord Chen!” The extraterrestrial visitors all clasped their hands in greeting, their expressions solemn.
This was a Spirit Transformation True Lord, and even in the universe, this was considered a great elite. Who dared to disrespect him?
This wasn’t something like Empress Ma, only someone related to Chen Fengyan. Instead, it was a True Lord that was manifesting his intent, and it was as if they were facing Chen Fengyan.

The shadowy figure raised a hand, “You all have come to search for fated opportunities. I have the capacity to accommodate the whole world, and will not do anything to you, but if you harm my citizens, I will not spare you.” “Yes.” The extraterrestrial visitors all obeyed. No one dared to talk back to a Spirit Transformation True Lord. That would be courting death..
