chapters.title: Chapter 3646 - Envoy from the Holy Land
paragraphs: Envoy from the Holy Land
Translator: Henyee Translations ] Editor: Henyee Translations
After the light-person finished speaking, his body turned into bits of light that disappeared without a trace.
What was this Chen Fengyan doing all day? Why did he always send his doppelganger or mental projection to do things? It was almost impossible to see his true self.
Could it be that he was about to break through to the fourth pinnacle level, and wanted to become a great elite of Sect Master-level?
It was possible. Thus, he was very tolerant now, because as long as he became a
Sect Master level, how could the likes of the Primordial True Lord and others be able to withstand a single strike from him?

The conflict that was about to happen was resolved, but the atmosphere could no longer go back to how it had once been. The extraterrestrial visitors all had ugly expressions. They were actually suppressed by a Mystery Realm Tier, which made them feel suffocated.
But in a battle of equal cultivation levels, they were really no match.
“Hmph, what’s the point of a Mystery Realm Tier being invincible among his peers?”
“That’s right. When they leaped over the Celestial Gate, how many prodigies
had died?”
“You can only show off a little now. After he advances into the Celestial Path, in a battle of equal cultivation levels, I will be able to kill him easily.
“Foundation Building Tier is the starting point of cultivation. It’s completely meaningless to compare to the mortal level.
Not long after, these extraterrestrial visitors all became excited on their own, and belittled Ling Han without caring about the facts.
This was very infuriating. They were clearly outmatched in a battle of equal cultivation levels, yet still turned around to mock him.
Ling Han didn’t say anything. He simply retrieved the treasures that he had just won and placed them on the table.
Instantly, those extraterrestrial visitors were rendered speechless.
These stakes were their humiliation, and also Ling Han’s battle merits. What else could they say?
The banquet continued, but everyone lost interest.

The extraterrestrial visitors all hoped that the banquet would end quickly, so that they could leave, while the subjects of the Dark North Nation were discussing Ling Han spiritedly. As expected, His Majesty still thought very highly of this young prodigy. Should they find a chance to stuff some women of marriageable age into the Foreign Affairs Department?
The main characters of this banquet were obviously the Eldest Imperial Prince and the others, but now, everyone was thinking of Ling Han. It was just that different people had different feelings.
Empress Ma saw this, and also felt that it was meaningless for the banquet to continue. She stood up, and was just about to announce the end of the banquet.
However, right at this moment, boom! A meteor suddenly streaked across the
sky.
Yi, it looked so familiar.
Not good, it was the little loli Tang Yun’er, who had crashed over with the shuttle.

Ling Han was just about to use the Imminent Skyline to leave, when he discovered that the meteor had actually braked abruptly, and stopped in midair in an incredibly bizarre manner. It was only about 30 meters above their heads.
It wasn’t Tang Yun’er.
Ling Han thought to himself. Firstly, the little loli didn’t have such good skills that she could stop just like that. Secondly, the shuttle looked different.

“Very good. With so many people here, it can also save me a lot of time.” A voice was heard from within the shuttle, “I am an envoy from the Holy Land of Metal Element, and have especially come for the Metal Element Fruit Gathering that is held in a year’s time.”
“Holy Land of Metal Element!”
“Metal Element Fruit Gathering!”
All of a sudden, the extraterrestrial visitors became incredibly excited. They naturally knew what the words “Holy Land of Metal Element” represented.
A Holy Land, only those forces that had produced Saints would be qualified to be called a Holy Land.

The shuttle slowly stopped, and a middle-aged man walked out from within. His expression was extraordinarily proud. Thinking about it, it made sense. Coming from a force of Saint-level, it was understandable that he was extremely proud.
“Greetings, rniord!” The extraterrestrial visitors all bowed in greeting, their faces all smiles.

Seeing their expressions, no matter how stupid the people from the Dark North Nation were, they knew that the Holy Land of Metal Element was extremely awesome, and this Metal Element Fruit Gathering was probably also extremely grand, and they would be able to obtain great benefits.
The middle-aged man wore a reserved expression. Although he was only at the Foundation Building Tier, with his background, even elites at the Core Formation Tier would treat him with utmost respect.

He was very pleased with the treatment he was receiving, yet deliberately kept a straight face, and said calmly, “I have been commanded to come here to find prodigies, and bestow them the qualifications to participate in the Metal Element Fruit Gathering. I had not thought that there would be so many prodigies in this declining land.”
“Lord, you may not know, but I am not from the Celestial Sea Planet. I am from the Flying Rain Sect of the Crimson Alchemy Planet.”
“I’m from the Nine Sinking Sect of Setting Sun Planet.”

Everyone introduced themselves, one after another. They hurriedly drew a clear dividing line between themselves and the Celestial Sea Planet. They had no wish to be thought of as natives of a backward place.

“So that’s how it is.” The middle-aged man nodded. His name was Wan Ziping, and after being sucked up to like crazy, he naturally announced his name. Being called Lord Wan repeatedly, he felt even more pleased.
“Never mind. I am commanded to search for prodigies. I don’t care about background, as long as they are talented enough.”
“Come, everyone, step forwards one by one. As long as you place your hand on the shuttle, this Spirit Tool will automatically judge whether you are qualified to go to the Holy Land of Metal Element.

He was a little overbearing, but the Holy Land and Fruit Gathering that he had thrown out had struck them dizzy. Even Empress Ma and the Eldest Imperial Prince did not step forwards to stop him. Instead, they first sent someone to investigate the situation.
After learning of the background of the Holy Land of Metal Element, they all inhaled sharply.
Saint!
What kind of lofty existence was this? There was no need for him to make a move at all. A single thought was enough to make the Celestial Sea Planet crumble.

Of course, having a Saint appear and having a Saint present were two completely different matters. However, even if the Holy Land of Metal Element no longer had Saints, who could compare to their background?
There was definitely a Saint Tool suppressing the Holy Land, and even if a Venerate Tier cultivator went, they would only be seeking death.
Everyone obediently queued up. Not one of them dared to shout loudly, fearing that they would be disqualified.
“Those below Celestial Path don’t have to join in on the excitement,” Wan Ziping said. He pulled a person out of the group, his expression filled with disdain.
What, the lowest requirement to qualify was Foundation Building Tier?
This was enough to eliminate 99°/° ofthepeople here.
Meanwhile, the extraterrestrial visitors all wore cold smirks. What kind of place did he think the Holy Land of Metal Element was? Did he think that just anyone had the right to go there?
Quite a number of people’s eyes flew towards Ling Han. So what if you are freakish?
Without reaching the Foundation Building Tier, one wouldn’t even be qualified to undergo the test!
Haha, he could only watch wide-eyed as the great opportunity flew away. He must be feeling very terrible.

The test was in progress, and those who passed would be enshrouded by a ray of light, which would leave behind a mark. This was the qualification for participation in the Metal Element Fruit Gathering.
Those who had passed naturally looked pleased, while those who had not looked livid.
judging by the current situation, if one wanted to pass, they would have to be a one-star genius.
Princess Bixiao walked over, curtsied to Wan Ziping, and said, “Bixiao pays respects to Lord Wan.”
Wan Ziping’s eyes involuntarily lit up. This kind of beauty was really rare. Even in the Holy Daughter, merely in terms of beauty, she could be ranked among the Holy Daughters.
He couldn’t help but become gentle, and asked, “What is it?

“Bixiao earnestly requests for an exception, Lord,” Princess Bixiao said. She pointed at Ling Han, and continued, “This is Ling Han, and he’s currently Mystery Realm Tier, and he’s invincible against those at the same cultivation level. Moreover, he’s only a step away from reaching the Celestial Path. One year is enough for him to reach the Foundation Building Tier.
“You want me to make an exception for him and grant him the right?” Wan Ziping asked.
“Yes.” Princess Bixiao curtsied.

Wan Ziping couldn’t help but laugh loudly, “A mere backward place, and someone actually dares to boast that he is invincible among his peers? Rules are rules.. Without reaching the Foundation Building Tier, what right do you have to go to the Holy Land?”

Could it be that he was about to break through to the fourth pinnacle level, and wanted to become a great elite of Sect Master-level?
It was possible.
Thus, he was very tolerant now, because as long as he became a
Sect Master level, how could the likes of the Primordial True Lord and others be able to withstand a single strike from him?
The conflict that was about to happen was resolved, but the atmosphere could no longer go back to how it had once been.
The extraterrestrial visitors all had ugly expressions.
They were actually suppressed by a Mystery Realm Tier, which made them feel suffocated.
But in a battle of equal cultivation levels, they were really no match.
“Hmph, what’s the point of a Mystery Realm Tier being invincible among his peers?”
“That’s right.
When they leaped over the Celestial Gate, how many prodigies
had died?”
“You can only show off a little now.
After he advances into the Celestial Path, in a battle of equal cultivation levels, I will be able to kill him easily.
“Foundation Building Tier is the starting point of cultivation.
It’s completely meaningless to compare to the mortal level.
Not long after, these extraterrestrial visitors all became excited on their own, and belittled Ling Han without caring about the facts.
This was very infuriating.
They were clearly outmatched in a battle of equal cultivation levels, yet still turned around to mock him.
Ling Han didn’t say anything.
He simply retrieved the treasures that he had just won and placed them on the table.
Instantly, those extraterrestrial visitors were rendered speechless.
These stakes were their humiliation, and also Ling Han’s battle merits.
What else could they say?
The banquet continued, but everyone lost interest.
The extraterrestrial visitors all hoped that the banquet would end quickly, so that they could leave, while the subjects of the Dark North Nation were discussing Ling Han spiritedly.
As expected, His Majesty still thought very highly of this young prodigy.
Should they find a chance to stuff some women of marriageable age into the Foreign Affairs Department?
The main characters of this banquet were obviously the Eldest Imperial Prince and the others, but now, everyone was thinking of Ling Han.
It was just that different people had different feelings.
Empress Ma saw this, and also felt that it was meaningless for the banquet to continue.
She stood up, and was just about to announce the end of the banquet.
However, right at this moment, boom!
A meteor suddenly streaked across the
sky.
Yi, it looked so familiar.
Not good, it was the little loli Tang Yun’er, who had crashed over with the shuttle.
Ling Han was just about to use the Imminent Skyline to leave, when he discovered that the meteor had actually braked abruptly, and stopped in midair in an incredibly bizarre manner.
It was only about 30 meters above their heads.
It wasn’t Tang Yun’er.
Ling Han thought to himself.
Firstly, the little loli didn’t have such good skills that she could stop just like that.
Secondly, the shuttle looked different.
“Very good.

With so many people here, it can also save me a lot of time.” A voice was heard from within the shuttle, “I am an envoy from the Holy Land of Metal Element, and have especially come for the Metal Element Fruit Gathering that is held in a year’s time.”
“Holy Land of Metal Element!”
“Metal Element Fruit Gathering!”
All of a sudden, the extraterrestrial visitors became incredibly excited.
They naturally knew what the words “Holy Land of Metal Element” represented.
A Holy Land, only those forces that had produced Saints would be qualified to be called a Holy Land.
The shuttle slowly stopped, and a middle-aged man walked out from within.
His expression was extraordinarily proud.
Thinking about it, it made sense.
Coming from a force of Saint-level, it was understandable that he was extremely proud.
“Greetings, rniord!” The extraterrestrial visitors all bowed in greeting, their faces all smiles.

Seeing their expressions, no matter how stupid the people from the Dark North Nation were, they knew that the Holy Land of Metal Element was extremely awesome, and this Metal Element Fruit Gathering was probably also extremely grand, and they would be able to obtain great benefits.
The middle-aged man wore a reserved expression.
Although he was only at the Foundation Building Tier, with his background, even elites at the Core Formation Tier would treat him with utmost respect.

He was very pleased with the treatment he was receiving, yet deliberately kept a straight face, and said calmly, “I have been commanded to come here to find prodigies, and bestow them the qualifications to participate in the Metal Element Fruit Gathering.
I had not thought that there would be so many prodigies in this declining land.”
“Lord, you may not know, but I am not from the Celestial Sea Planet.
I am from the Flying Rain Sect of the Crimson Alchemy Planet.”
“I’m from the Nine Sinking Sect of Setting Sun Planet.”
Everyone introduced themselves, one after another.
They hurriedly drew a clear dividing line between themselves and the Celestial Sea Planet.
They had no wish to be thought of as natives of a backward place.
“So that’s how it is.” The middle-aged man nodded.
His name was Wan Ziping, and after being sucked up to like crazy, he naturally announced his name.
Being called Lord Wan repeatedly, he felt even more pleased.
“Never mind.
I am commanded to search for prodigies.
I don’t care about background, as long as they are talented enough.”
“Come, everyone, step forwards one by one.
As long as you place your hand on the shuttle, this Spirit Tool will automatically judge whether you are qualified to go to the Holy Land of Metal Element.
He was a little overbearing, but the Holy Land and Fruit Gathering that he had thrown out had struck them dizzy.
Even Empress Ma and the Eldest Imperial Prince did not step forwards to stop him.
Instead, they first sent someone to investigate the situation.
After learning of the background of the Holy Land of Metal Element, they all inhaled sharply.
Saint!
What kind of lofty existence was this?
There was no need for him to make a move at all.
A single thought was enough to make the Celestial Sea Planet crumble.
Of course, having a Saint appear and having a Saint present were two completely different matters.
However, even if the Holy Land of Metal Element no longer had Saints, who could compare to their background?
There was definitely a Saint Tool suppressing the Holy Land, and even if a Venerate Tier cultivator went, they would only be seeking death.
Everyone obediently queued up.
Not one of them dared to shout loudly, fearing that they would be disqualified.
“Those below Celestial Path don’t have to join in on the excitement,” Wan Ziping said.
He pulled a person out of the group, his expression filled with disdain.
What, the lowest requirement to qualify was Foundation Building Tier?
This was enough to eliminate 99°/° ofthepeople here.
Meanwhile, the extraterrestrial visitors all wore cold smirks.
What kind of place did he think the Holy Land of Metal Element was?
Did he think that just anyone had the right to go there?
Quite a number of people’s eyes flew towards Ling Han.
So what if you are freakish?
Without reaching the Foundation Building Tier, one wouldn’t even be qualified to undergo the test!
Haha, he could only watch wide-eyed as the great opportunity flew away.
He must be feeling very terrible.
The test was in progress, and those who passed would be enshrouded by a ray of light, which would leave behind a mark.
This was the qualification for participation in the Metal Element Fruit Gathering.
Those who had passed naturally looked pleased, while those who had not looked livid.
judging by the current situation, if one wanted to pass, they would have to be a one-star genius.
Princess Bixiao walked over, curtsied to Wan Ziping, and said, “Bixiao pays respects to Lord Wan.”
Wan Ziping’s eyes involuntarily lit up.
This kind of beauty was really rare.
Even in the Holy Daughter, merely in terms of beauty, she could be ranked among the Holy Daughters.
He couldn’t help but become gentle, and asked, “What is it?
“Bixiao earnestly requests for an exception, Lord,” Princess Bixiao said.
She pointed at Ling Han, and continued, “This is Ling Han, and he’s currently Mystery Realm Tier, and he’s invincible against those at the same cultivation level.
Moreover, he’s only a step away from reaching the Celestial Path.
One year is enough for him to reach the Foundation Building Tier.
“You want me to make an exception for him and grant him the right?” Wan Ziping asked.
“Yes.” Princess Bixiao curtsied.
Wan Ziping couldn’t help but laugh loudly, “A mere backward place, and someone actually dares to boast that he is invincible among his peers?
Rules are rules..
Without reaching the Foundation Building Tier, what right do you have to go to the Holy Land?”

chapters.title: Chapter 3647 - Another way
paragraphs: Another way
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations

“That’s right. What right does a mere Mystery Realm Tier have to be on the same level as us?” Zhou Yang and the others immediately began to mock and ridicule him. The few people who had lost to Ling Han were all one-star geniuses. They all passed the test and obtained a spot.
This comparison was very stark. They had stood out from the rest, but Ling Han was not even qualified to take part in the test. Hehe.
Princess Bixiao still wanted to say something, yet Wan Ziping waved her off, expressing clear refusal.
Ling Han walked over, smiled, and said, “No need to waste your breath on him.”

“But, the Metal Element Fruit Gathering is really very important,” Princess Bixiao said anxiously. “Don’t be rash! I’ve asked around just now, and the Holy Land of Metal Element will hold a Metal Element Fruit Gathering every twenty years. Not only will supreme celestial techniques be taught, but there will also be celestial fruits that the Holy Land of Metal Element has been keeping in their treasure chamber.”
“If you can attend the Metal Element Fruit Gathering, it would be enough to save you a hundred years, or even several hundred years of cultivation time.”
Ling Han cracked a smile, “I didn’t say I wasn’t going.”
Princess Bixiao was stunned. ‘You’re not even qualified to participate in the test, so how are you supposed to go?’
“Don’t worry. We don’t necessarily need to depend on him to go to the Holy Land of Metal Element.” Ling Han smiled, and said, “Alright, don’t worry about my matters. It’s like you are my wife.”
“You still have a glib tongue!” Princess Bixiao stomped her feet in anger.
Everyone was tested, one after another, and even the Eldest Imperial Prince and the others were no exception.
Holy Land, what kind of place was that!
However, the Eldest Imperial Prince passed, the Seventh Imperial Prince also passed, and the other Imperial Princes were mercilessly dismissed.

“Three days later, head to these coordinates. The Holy Land will activate a large-scale formation to teleport all of you over,” Wan Ziping said, announcing a set of coordinates. Then, he sneered, “Those who have not passed the test need not waste time. There are no marks on your bodies. After the formation is activated, you will be crushed to death.”
“I’ll only say it once. If you guys don’t believe me, you’re courting death.”
“I still have to find other prodigies. I’m leaving.”
Wan Ziping once again entered into the shuttle. Xiu, he tore through the air and left.

“Hahahaha!” The extraterrestrial visitors laughed loudly. They had practically all passed the test, and those that could be sent here were naturally prodigy-level. As they looked at Ling Han, their expressions were filled with mockery.
What use would it be if you were invincible in Mystery Realm Tier?
Weren’t you very arrogant just now? Now, just try and continue acting arrogant.
Ling Han looked at them coldly, and there was only one saying in his mind: vile characters who have attained success.
He naturally had to attend the Metal Element Fruit Gathering. However, he wouldn’t go through Wan Ziping. Instead, he would go directly.

One year’s time was enough for him to advance into Celestial Path, and directly explode on the planet of the Holy Land of Metal Element. How could such a prodigy not be extended an olive branch to the Holy Land of Metal Element?
‘Heh, when the time comes, I’ll still beat you guys until you call me grandpa.’

Zhou Yang and the others all prepared to set out. The Eldest and the Seventh Imperial Princes did the same. This was a Holu Land! If they could cultivate a Saint -level technique, then even if they couldn’t become Saints in the future, what about Venerate Tier, Sect Master, and so on? They could at least aspire to that.

This temptation was too great, and no one could resist. They all moved out, fearing that they would be delayed by something. If they could not go to the Holy Land of Metal Element, wouldn’t that be a great loss?

Princess Bixiao naturally passed the test as well, and received a place. She and Ling Han returned to the Foreign Affairs Department, and did not speak on their way back. She was still angry at Ling Han for missing out on such a great opportunity.

Ling Han merely smiled. Even if he really missed this opportunity, he would not feel much heartache either, because he had even obtained the Origin Gold. That was something that even Saints would be envious of.
En, going to a great planet like the Holy Land of Metal Element, there should be Heavenly Dao Flames, right?
He could use this opportunity to refine the Imperial Weapon.
On the second day, Princess Bixiao set out. Time was limited, and she had to hurry.
“Without me here, you must be careful,” she warned. “The Second and the Third Imperial Princes are all in Foundation Building Tier. You are no match for them, so you must not act rashly.”
“Alright, alright, I’m not an idiot,” Ling Han said with a smile.
Princess Bixiao gave him some more instructions before leaving.

A few days later, news came. Wan Ziping had already left the Celestial Sea Planet and gone to other planets. He had also gone to the Primordial Sect, the Nine Spirits Sect, and the other great Spirit Transformation True Lord-level Sects, issuing some entry slots.
Including Hong Tianbu, the few prodigies that could be counted had all left Celestial Sea Planet. They were directly brought to the Holy Land of Metal Element by a large formation.
The galaxy projection could transmigrate through space. This was a Saint’s technique.
The Celestial Sea Planet instantly fell silent. The numerous prodigies left one after another, causing this newly revived planet to lose a great deal of its vitality.

Ling Han stayed true to his heart. He cultivated diligently every day, and on the other hand, he was also searching for pill recipes above Celestial Path. Once he had stepped onto the Celestial Path, he would begin concocting Celestial pills to assist in martial arts.

The Celestial Sea Planet’s path of cultivation had been severed before, and even if heaven and earth revived now, most of the information had already been destroyed. What Ling Han could find was considerably limited.
He hadn’t found the pill recipes, but he had obtained an ancient book that was related to alchemy. It introduced Celestial medicines.
This was quite useful. If he didn’t even know how to recognize herbs, how could he concoct alchemical pills?

This book introduced the medicinal effects of various Celestial medicines, which clashed with certain attributes of Celestial medicines, how they merged, and about the environment of their growth, whether these celestial medicines preferred a cold or warm environment, and so on. It was very comprehensive.
Ling Han was enthralled, and he was already deducing in his mind which medicinal ingredients he should combine with which medicinal ingredients and what effects they could produce.

Of course, he would never forget his daily cultivation when the sun rose. Now that the apertures all over his body had opened when he was cultivating, absorbing the power of heaven and earth together would greatly increase his cultivation speed.
The number of apertures that an Enlightenment Tier cultivator opened was directly related to the future prospects of a cultivator.

Even if Ling Han didn’t have any special cultivation technique, his cultivation speed was still several times faster than the normal Mystery Realm Tier. Combined with Brother Monkey Cultivation Technique, and the supplementary cultivation technique, his cultivation speed could be dozens or even hundreds of times faster than others.
Every few days, he would be able to welcome an upgrade to his level of being, unlocking a few shackles. Two months later, Ling Han calculated that he still had 78 shackles that he had yet to shatter.

This result was extremely shocking. One had to realize that ordinary Mystery Realm Tiers would only be able to unlock 10% of the shackles on their bodies at most. The potential of this was imaginable. At most, they would only be able to advance to the Foundation Building Tier and would not have the power to advance any further..
Only prodigies could unlock more than half of the shackles, but reaching 90% could practically be considered a flawless physique.

And in Ling Han’s case, the shackles he had unlocked had already surpassed 99%. Looking at the world, there were probably not many that could compare to him, but he naturally would not be satisfied just like that. He had to pursue absolute perfection.

However, the fewer the remaining shackles, the slower the improvement of this level of being would be. Previously, it could be unlocked once every six to seven days, and now, it would need half a month.
Going by this calculation, even though there were only 78 shackles left, it was very likely that he would need seven to eight years to break through them.

This was like how the difficulty of raising one’s score from zero to one point could not be compared with the difficulty of raising one’s score from 99 to 100. The further one progressed, the slower their progress would be.
Ling Han believed that he would definitely be able to break through all the shackles in his body, but this time... was too long.
Right at this moment, the Imperial Family released a huge piece of news..

chapters.title: Chapter 3648 - Obtaining a spot by defeating Ling Han
paragraphs: Obtaining a spot by defeating Ling Han
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations
The Cleansing Pool was about to open.
What was the Cleansing Pool?
This was an extremely great opportunity for mortal tier cultivators. It could provide them with astonishing energy, helping the cultivator to activate the evolution of the level of being.
Every planet had a Cleansing Pool, and the difference was that the higher the level of the planet, the better the effects of the Cleansing Pool.
However, the effects of the Celestial Sea Planet’s Cleansing Pool would definitely not be inferior to the other great planets.
Why?

This was because the Cleansing Pool of other planets would open once every ten years after accumulating energy. However, how much energy had the Celestial Sea Planet’s Cleansing Pool accumulated this time?
More than two thousand years!
Two thousand years couldn’t compare to ten years of savings?

Of course, not everyone could enter into the Cleansing Pool. First, one had to reach the Mystery Realm Tier. Otherwise, when the majestic energy surged into the body, the body would not be able to bear it at all, and would directly explode.

And even if one had advanced into the Mystery Realm Tier, they would still have to use their abilities to earn the right to enter the Cleansing Pool. After all, there was a limit to the energy in the Cleansing Pool. Once there were too many people, no one would be able to get much.
Chen Fengyan had appeared long ago, and he had planned for many years. This was evident from the fact that he had built the Imperial Capital here. He already had a plan in mind.
Thus, something as valuable as the Cleansing Pool was naturally under the control of Chen Fengyan. After all, he had once been the crown prince of this planet, so what did he not know?
However, one of the 10 spots had already been directly assigned to Ling Han.
No one was unconvinced. Ling Han’s strength had come from battle, and this was publicly acknowledged.
Thus, everyone set their eyes on the remaining nine spots, and began a martial arts tournament.
The tournament continued for seven days, and just when the top nine were about to be decided, another shocking piece of news spread out.
The four Spirit Transformation True Lords came together to ask Chen Fengyan to leave two spots for each of their forces.
The Cleansing Pool could only accommodate ten people, and now eight were being sent by the four great True Lords, so wouldn’t there only be two spots left for the Dark North Nation?
Everyone was naturally unconvinced. This was the wealth of the Dark North Nation, so what right did they have to take it out to share?
However, none of them could interfere. Only a Spirit Transformation True Lord was qualified to make a decision.
Ling Han didn’t know what Chen Fengyan and the others were discussing. In any case, the five True Lords had reached a consensus to battle.

The most important thing for cultivators was naturally their abilities. This was very normal. However, the people fighting this time wasn’t Chen Fengyan and the others, but rather the Mystery Realm Tiers.

Chen Fengyan had announced that if they wanted to enter into the Cleansing Pool, they could do so. They only had to defeat Ling Han. If they defeated him once, one person could enter, and if they defeated him 10 times, 10 people could enter.
When Ling Han found out, he was naturally unconcerned. He was invincible among his peers, and could do as he liked.

Since Chen Fengyan had already made his decision, the four True Lords had no choice but to accept. This was because Chen Fengyan had already said that the Cleansing Pool was only reserved for the most outstanding youths. If they couldn’t even defeat Ling Han, it would be a waste even if they entered.
Ling Han was depressed. He was clearly invincible in Mystery Realm Tier. Why did he seem to have become a benchmark for judging strength?
Was there really a Mystery Realm Tier that could defeat him in this world?
To say nothing of defeat, was there anyone that could fight him to a tie?
However, he was on opposing sides from the four True Lords. Moreover, he was Chen Fengyan’s subject, so he had to support him at this moment.
It wasn’t long before the four True Lords each sent ten young prodigies into the Imperial Capital. They were all Mystery Realm Tiers.
Ling Han, on the other hand, was a little surprised. So many Mystery Realm Tier prodigies?

He did not believe that it was so coincidental. No one had managed to advance into Celestial Path before Wan Ziping had arrived. They must have deliberately suppressed their cultivation level, wanting to wait for this great opportunity of the Cleansing Pool.
The four great elites had been trapped on the Celestial Sea Planet for over 2000 years, so they definitely had a good understanding of the Celestial Sea Planet.
If they wanted a battle, so be it. Who would be afraid of who?
Three days later, the great battle began, and innumerable spectators watched.

Ling Han leaped onto the martial arts ring, and said directly, “There’s no need to compete one by one. Come on up onto the martial arts ring. I’m in a hurry. After I defeat all of you, I’ll go back and eat.”
Those Mystery Realm Tiers were all enraged. ‘You’re too arrogant, aren’t you? So condescending?’
They were all prodigies, so it would only be them that would ask others to attack them together.
Ling Han cracked a smile, “Still reserved? All right, then I’ll do it!”
He leaped out, and began to attack those forty people.
Peng! Peng! Peng!
In just three punches, he had sent seven people flying, showing his invincible bearing.
“Ling Han!” “Ling Han!” “Ling Han!” “Ling Han!”
The spectators were all shouting loudly, their emotions instantly ignited, and they became incredibly crazy.

chapters.title: Chapter 3649 - Cleansing Pool
paragraphs: Cleansing Pool
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations
The young man in blue looked at Ling Han as if he was looking at a monster.

Ling Han’s body was enveloped by the Starlight Screen. This awakened Mystical Power possessed astonishing defenses. Even though the woman in red had tried her best just then, she still hadn’t been able to break through his defenses. She had been sent flying.
The young man in blue was about to go crazy. How could there be such a freakish person? He was invincible just by charging around like a bull.
He hurriedly spread out his body, thinking, ‘If I was in a state of high-speed movement, how would you be able to crash into me?’
Xiu, xiu, xiu! His speed was extremely fast, and at close to seven times the speed of sound, the whole martial arts arena was filled with sonic booms, like endless thunder.
Yet Ling Han had absolutely no intention of making a move. He drew out a chair and sat down, as he munched on sunflower seeds.
’F*ck! Do you think I’m a sideshow?’

The young man in blue exploded in fury, yet did not dare slow down in the slightest. He had already witnessed the explosive speed and impact of Ling Han’s attacks. Ling Han was definitely not someone that he could contend against.
‘But why don’t you make your move!1
The blue-robed young man felt extremely terrible. He was running around like an idiot, but his opponent was just sitting there as if he was watching a show. In comparison, wasn’t he like a clown?
On the spectators’ seats, the spectators were also stunned, their expressions strange.

The previous battle had ended too quickly. Ling Han was invincible, sending one person or even a few people flying with a single punch. Under his collision, even stronger prodigies could only lose in grievance, which made them feel very satisfied. It was too fast, and they had not managed to catch sight of it, and could not recall it.
But now? The battle had dragged on, but it was really too boring.
Just to watch a person run off like he was in heat?
“Fight!” someone shouted.
“Hurry up and make your move. Aren’t you very strong? Hurry up and make your move!” Many people shouted at the blue-robed young man.
The young man in blue roamed around for a while longer. He knew that he could not drag things on like this.
Ling Han remained silent, not expending the slightest bit of energy. If this continued, it would definitely be disadvantageous to him.
He raised his hand and delivered a palm strike, which transformed into a gust of energy that slashed towards Ling Han.
Ling Han cracked a smile, “Finally know to make your move?”
He launched a counterattack. As he threw a punch, the apertures all over his body shot out bursts of energy that blotted out the sky and covered the earth as they shot towards the young man in blue.
The young man in blue greeted the attack, but it was only a flash of energy, and he was shaken to the point that his whole body was trembling violently.
He couldn’t help but feel stunned. With his strength, it was actually so difficult for him to take on one of the energy released from Ling Han’s apertures?
Just what kind of colossal power gap was this?
Ling Han moved. His speed was even faster, and no matter how the young man in blue dodged, it was useless. Very soon, Ling Han caught up to him, and sent him flying with a punch.
At this point, all the challengers had been defeated.
The spectators were all cheering. This was their Imperial City’s twin prodigies — no, there were no more twin prodigies now. There was only the one and only prodigy, Ling Han!
Ling Han smiled at his surroundings before turning around to leave.
This kind of battle merit was indeed impressive, but in his eyes, it was only so. What he pursued was the strongest. Being invincible in Mystery Realm Tier did not mean anything.
He was anticipating the Cleansing Pool that would be opening in a few days.

The four Spirit Transformation True Lords left helplessly. They were people who cared about their pride. Chen Fengyan had given them a chance to compete fairly, but their disciples were incompetent, so who could they blame?
Peace had temporarily returned to the Imperial Capital, and Ling Han had been adjusting his condition these few days, reaching his peak.
Four days later, the Cleansing Pool opened.

This was actually within the range of the Imperial Palace. It was located underground, and after Ling Han and the other nine Mystery Realm Tier entered the Imperial Palace, they arrived at the foot of a mountain and entered a cave. They walked all the way downwards, and after walking for a long time, the path ahead of them finally became clear, revealing a massive karst cave.

In this karst cave, there was also an irregularly shaped pool. One end was connected to the cave wall, and at the bottom of this pool, there was a green lotus that had just poked out of the water’s surface.

“Enter the pool on your own. You all have three days, and after three days, I will inform you to leave.” Zhu Qi, the chief eunuch, said, “Do not harm that azure lotus, or else... you will have to bear the consequences.”
After saying this, Zhu Qi turned around and left.
Ling Han and the others didn’t stand on ceremony and didn’t greet each other either. They all walked into the pool.
Time was limited, so they definitely couldn’t waste it.

Ling Han sat down in a cross-legged position. The warm waters of the pool enveloped him, and he immediately discovered that the life force in his body was surging, as if he was about to immediately break through.
Pa, a shackle was instantly removed.
There were only 77 left.
As expected of the Cleansing Pool, its effects were immediately apparent.
Ling Han continued to absorb the energy in the pool waters. His life force surged, and in a short while, his life force evolved again.
Pa, pa, pa! The shackles shattered one after another.
70, 60, 50... there were fewer and fewer remaining shackles.
Merely a day later, there were only three shackles left in Ling Han’s body.
However, at this time, even with the help of the Cleansing Pool, Ling Han’s level of being evolution had also entered a complete stagnation.
There were only three shackles left. For anyone, this was already perfect enough, but for Ling Han, three shackles was the same as one shackle or a hundred shackles. It was still flawed.
They definitely had to be broken.
Open, open, open!

Ling Han roared internally, pushing the energy in his body with all his might. He also used the Power of Dimensions, which was extremely important on his path of cultivation. He had broken through all pinnacle levels with its aid.
Pa, the first shackle was blasted open. Ling Han was neither happy nor sad. He mustered up the remaining power to launch another attack. Pa, the second shackle was shattered.
However, by this time, the Power of Dimension in his body had already begun to decline.
Ling Han frowned upon hearing this. The Cleansing Pool was already ineffective on him. Now that he had used up the Power of Dimension, how was he supposed to break through the final barrier?
No, with the help of the Cleansing Pool, he was already powerless, so what other chances would he have in the future?
Perhaps there was, but he needed to accumulate power for ten years, fifty years, or even longer, before he could break through the final barrier in one go.
He couldn’t wait that long.
He had to take advantage of this opportunity to succeed in a single stroke.
Ling Han’s blood boiled, pushing his condition to its strongest state.
‘Hmm?’
The other nine opened their eyes and looked towards him.
‘What’s going on? Why is your blood boiling when you’re cultivating? Are you trying to get into a fight?’
Boom, it was as if a tsunami had risen up in Ling Han’s body, the power of life surging.
Pa, the last shackle was also blasted open.
He was flawless.
Ling Han broke into a smile. Now, if he accumulated some more mystical power, he would be able to break through to Celestial Path.
Yi?

He was astounded, because the energy from the Cleansing Pool was still surging into his body. There was no way to stimulate the evolution of his level of being, yet it had turned into mystical power, endlessly surging into his body.
His meridians were incredibly wide, automatically guiding a large amount of energy into the dimensions inside his body.

If it was any other Mystery Realm Tier, after absorbing it for an hour or so, they would definitely have reached satiation from a state of exhaustion of all mystical power. However, what was Ling Han’s appetite?
There were countless dimensions in his body, and the space to store mystical power could be said to be close to unlimited, so how could it be filled to the brim?
It didn’t matter if he couldn’t fill it up, but the hunger that had been entangling him all this while was beginning to weaken..

chapters.title: Chapter 3650 - Leaping over the Celestial Gate
paragraphs: Leaping over the Celestial Gate
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations
This kind of hunger was not fatal, but it would not go away, and he would always feel uncomfortable.
Now, a large amount of mystical power was endlessly filling into the dimensions inside his body, naturally making Ling Han feel like he was finally going to eat something.
The Cleansing Pool had only opened after waiting for more than 2000 years. Just how powerful was its accumulation?
Ling Han remained calm and collected, silently making a fortune.
A day passed, and seven of Ling Han’s dimensions had been filled up. During this period of time, he had also used the power of the Cleansing Pool to connect to all the dimensions in his body.
This was a small matter. He only needed to pull the strings, and there was no need to open up a space.
However, Ling Han was also unable to absorb the slightest bit of energy. It was very simple. The energy in the Cleansing Pool had already been exhausted.
This was too terrifying. It had only been a little over a day, and the Cleansing Pool had already dried up?
The other nine stood up in confusion. What was going on here? Wasn’t it agreed that they could cultivate here for three days? It hadn’t even been a day and a half yet.
“What’s going on?”
“Why can’t I absorb any energy?”
“Me too.”
“The same.”
The nine of them all wore blank expressions. Ling Han also stood up, joining the ranks of “I’m also very confused”.

None of them were willing to give up, and continued to sit in the pool waters, waiting for the Cleansing Pool to glow with a “second spring”, but no matter how much they waited, the pool waters were the same. There was no more energy supply.
Three days had passed, and the chief eunuch, Zhu Qi, appeared, leading everyone out.
Everyone hurriedly asked about the situation, but Zhu Qi had never entered the Cleansing Pool before, so he naturally couldn’t answer. He only said that he would report this to His Majesty.
After returning to the Foreign Affairs Department, Ling Han began his final preparations. He was going to leap over the Celestial Gate and step onto the Celestial Path.

Ling Han gave himself three days to examine himself again. After taking this step, he would have left the mortal level and in the future, and it would be impossible for him to make up for the shortcomings of the mortal level.
Of course, if he could obtain the Saintly medicine, he would be able to compensate a little, but Saintly medicine? Heh.
Three days passed, and Ling Han no longer hesitated. He began to break through to Celestial Path.
In the current world, without the power of Celestial Path, it was difficult to travel anywhere.
The first step of Celestial Path, Foundation Building Tier.

However, the reason why the Celestial Path was so difficult to advance into was because this first step actually contained two steps. The first was to leap over the Celestial Gate, and the second was to build the Celestial Foundation.

Ling Han didn’t know how long his breakthrough would take, nor did he know if anyone would cause trouble for him during this process. Moreover, he didn’t know if he would cause any great commotion, so he didn’t break through in the Foreign Affairs Department. Instead, he arrived in a forest.
This was still within the boundaries of the Imperial Capital, so there was no need to worry that outsider cultivators would behave atrociously here, and Ling Han also chose a very hidden place.
He released his spirit, and he was only left with blankness. Then, he began to stimulate the great improvement of his level of being.
From mortal to Celestial, this was a qualitative change, and the gap was boundless.
Thus, Ling Han didn’t feel the bottleneck in his cultivation level loosen for a long time.
He was not in a rush. This was very normal. It would not be strange for an ordinary person to be stuck for eight to ten years, or even hundreds of years.

Although he hadn’t been a Mystery Realm Tier for a long time, this cultivation level was very special in the first place. There were two main points, and that was to shatter as many shackles as possible and accumulate enough mystical power. Otherwise, it wouldn’t even be enough to leap over the Celestial Gate.

For Ling Han, the shackles in his body had been fully unlocked, and the level of being in his body had already reached the pinnacle of the mortal level. As for the reserves of mystical power in his body, it had indeed been a weakness in the past, but after entering into the Cleansing Pool, he had already completed this portion.
Thus, he was already fully qualified to attempt breaking through to the Foundation Building Tier.
Ling Han accumulated appreciation, preparing for the impending explosion.
To his surprise, this moment had not come for a long time.
Two days, three days, four days... Ling Han was already feeling hungry. This time, it wasn’t that his mystical power hadn’t been filled, but that he was truly hungry.
He endured it, and did not destroy the mental state that he had painstakingly formed. Once it was destroyed, all his previous efforts would be wasted.
With his current cultivation level, not drinking water for ten days, and not eating for twenty days would not be a problem.
Five days, six days, seven days, hong, a drastic change suddenly took place in Ling Han’s body. The power of life exploded, and every cell was trembling, as if they were about to explode.
‘It’s here, it’s here, it’s here!’
Ling Han only felt his body tremble. It was as if his soul had exited his body and flown into the galaxy, instantly traversing an endless distance.
Where was this?
He finally stopped, and saw that his surroundings were pitch-black, and ahead of him was a massive bronze door.
The bronze door was three hundred meters tall and mottled all over, covered with veined patterns, as if it had experienced too many years.
This was... the Celestial Gate!
Ling Han was astonished. Right now, he was definitely in a soul state. However, was there truly such a place in the galaxy? Did a Celestial Gate exist?
He was not in a rush to leap. Instead, he walked closer, wanting to take a good look at this bronze door.
However, a force instantly repelled him. It was too powerful, and was not something that Ling Han could contend against at all, so he could not approach.

Ling Han focused his gaze, wanting to see clearly. However, no matter how hard he tried, he was still unable to see the veined patterns on the door. It was as if there was an invisible power blurring his vision.
He tried to activate his eye technique, but he was only a spirit form now, so how could he possibly use it?
He watched for a very long time, and only then did he reluctantly give up.
Forget it, he had best just directly leap over the Celestial Gate.
—If this was known to others, they would definitely find it inconceivable. Why are you so curious? Don’t you think that you should be doing proper business?
Ling Han leaped with all his might. In his spiritual soul state, he was very special, and was far taller than usual. Thus, the Celestial Gate that was 300 meters tall was easily leaped over by him.
Yi, then I am now a Celestial, and can build a Celestial Foundation?
He had not even finished this thought, when Ling Han felt that power come again, dragging him as he continued to soar through the dark galaxy.
After who knew how long, he appeared in a new place.
It was still dark all around them, but another door had appeared ahead of them.
After circling around for half a day, he had returned to the original spot?
No, the door ahead of him was not only 1500 meters tall, it was also white and silver in colour.
First, it was bronze, then it was silver. Could it be that there was a gold door after this?

Ling Han recalled what Princess Bixiao had said. She had crossed two Celestial Gates, but at the time, she had not explained in detail. If he had known earlier, he should have investigated in more detail.
Who cares? He would just continue to leap.
Ling Han still wanted to carefully observe this silver door first, but there was also a force stopping him from doing so.
Sigh!
Ling Han leaped over, easily crossing over this silver Celestial Gate.
However, his soul had not returned, when his soul was once again grabbed by a powerful force, and roamed through the galaxy.
When he stopped, a Celestial Gate appeared in front of him. Ling Han only gave an “oh”, and wasn’t so surprised.
Could it be that the higher one’s talent, the more Celestial Gates one could cross, and then the stronger one’s abilities would be?
However, Ling Han decided to try to get closer first. After discovering that he couldn’t, he would leap over. In any case, this wouldn’t take much time.
The golden Celestial Gate was unfathomably tall, but Ling Han still barely managed to leap over with a leap.
It should be about time, right? It should be time for his soul to return, right?
However... he did not..
